docs.subject: ent_llama-3-8b
docs.text: An 8-billion-parameter Meta Llama 3 auto-regressive language model, pretrained and instruction-tuned, intended for commercial and research use in English, with instruction-tuned versions built for assistant-like chat and pretrained ones for natural language generation.

docs.subject: ent_llama-3-70b
docs.text: A 70-billion-parameter Meta Llama 3 auto-regressive language model using an optimized transformer with Grouped-Query Attention, intended for commercial and research use in English, in pretrained and instruction-tuned chat variants.

docs.subject: ent_llama-3.1-405b
docs.text: The 405B member of the Meta Llama 3.1 collection of multilingual pretrained and instruction-tuned generative text models, intended for commercial and research use in multiple languages, including assistant-like chat.

docs.subject: ent_llama-3.2-11b
docs.text: An 11B multimodal image-reasoning model in the Llama 3.2-Vision collection, instruction-tuned and optimized for visual recognition, image reasoning, captioning, and answering general questions about an image.

docs.subject: ent_llama-3.2-90b
docs.text: The 90B model of the Llama 3.2-Vision collection of pretrained and instruction-tuned multimodal image reasoning models, for visual question answering, document understanding, image captioning, visual grounding, and assistant-like chat with images.

docs.subject: ent_llama-3.3-70b
docs.text: A 70B multilingual instruction-tuned generative model (text in/text out) using an optimized transformer architecture, intended for commercial and research use in multiple languages, primarily assistant-like chat.

docs.subject: prov_aion
docs.text: Aion Labs is an AI company operating under the tagline "Intelligence On Demand", offering access to language models through an OpenAI-compatible API alongside autonomous email agents that carry out research, drafting and document editing.

docs.subject: prov_aion
docs.text: AionLabs sells a hosted OpenAI-compatible LLM API and email-agent jobs billed from prepaid credits, and also publishes open-weight roleplay fine-tunes such as Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B on HuggingFace.

docs.subject: prov_anthracite
docs.text: Anthracite is not a company but a 28-member community organization on Hugging Face that collaboratively fine-tunes open large language models, best known for the Magnum series of models designed to replicate the prose quality of the Claude 3 models.

docs.subject: prov_anthracite
docs.text: Anthracite sells nothing: it releases free open weights on HuggingFace, including Magnum v1 through v4 at sizes from 9B to 123B plus GGUF and EXL2 quantizations, funded by donations through Open Collective.

docs.subject: prov_arcee
docs.text: Arcee AI is an American research lab that describes itself as "Building Open Intelligence" and develops open-weight language models, including the Trinity family of Large Thinking, Mini and Nano variants.

docs.subject: prov_arcee
docs.text: Arcee AI offers the hosted Arcee Open Models API (with a free chat interface at chat.arcee.ai) plus downloadable open-weight models from its open-source catalog on Hugging Face that customers can self-host, fine-tune and deploy on their own infrastructure.

docs.subject: prov_brave
docs.text: Brave Search is the search engine built by Brave Software, an Internet company "on a mission to build a user-first Web", and its Brave Search API exposes that independent index of over 30 billion pages to developers building agents and chatbots.

docs.subject: prov_brave
docs.text: Brave sells a hosted search API with endpoints for web, image, video and news search plus AI answers and autocomplete, priced at $5 per 1,000 requests on the Search plan and $4 per 1,000 requests plus $5 per million tokens on the Answers plan, each including $5 of free monthly credits.

docs.subject: prov_canopy
docs.text: Canopy Labs is a small AI lab working on speech, best known for Orpheus TTS, an open-source text-to-speech system built on a Llama backbone.

docs.subject: prov_canopy
docs.text: Canopy Labs gives away open weights rather than a hosted service, publishing 14 Orpheus TTS models on HuggingFace including pretrained and finetuned 3B English versions and multilingual research releases for Chinese, Hindi, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

docs.subject: prov_cognitive
docs.text: Cognitive Computations, now operating on HuggingFace as Dolphin ("dphn"), is an open-source AI research collective led by Eric Hartford rather than a conventional company, and it describes itself as "a project dedicated to pushing the boundaries of AI model development and distributed inference".

docs.subject: prov_cognitive
docs.text: The group releases free open-weight Dolphin instruct fine-tunes of other companies' base models — Llama 3, Mistral 24B, Qwen and others, in FP8 and GGUF variants — on HuggingFace, alongside a web chat and a Telegram bot, rather than selling its own inference API.

docs.subject: prov_firecrawl
docs.text: Firecrawl is a Y Combinator-backed company that builds a web data API for AI, letting agents and LLM applications search, scrape and interact with the web at scale.

docs.subject: prov_firecrawl
docs.text: Firecrawl sells a hosted, usage-priced API — search, scrape, crawl, document parsing and page interaction returning LLM-ready markdown, JSON or screenshots, with SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, Java and Elixir — with the underlying engine also available as open source.

docs.subject: prov_gryphe
docs.text: Gryphe (Gryphe Padar) is an individual model author on Hugging Face rather than a company, describing their work as "Pushing synthetic data generation to the next level" and best known for merged and fine-tuned open-weight language models aimed at roleplay and creative writing, such as MythoMax-L2-13B.

docs.subject: prov_gryphe
docs.text: Gryphe publishes free open weights on HuggingFace — merges and fine-tunes built on other organizations' base models such as Llama 2, Gemma and Qwen — and runs no hosted API, with third parties like OpenRouter selling inference on models such as MythoMax 13B.

docs.subject: prov_hexgrad
docs.text: Hexgrad is an individual developer on HuggingFace rather than a company, and is the author of Kokoro, an 82-million-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model, along with the Misaki grapheme-to-phoneme library.

docs.subject: prov_hexgrad
docs.text: Hexgrad sells nothing directly, releasing Kokoro-82M and related TTS work as open weights and code on HuggingFace and GitHub, with hosted Kokoro inference offered by third-party platforms.

docs.subject: prov_inception
docs.text: Inception Labs is an AI company that develops large language models based on diffusion rather than auto-regressive generation, marketed under the slogan "Every Millisecond Matters".

docs.subject: prov_inception
docs.text: Inception sells hosted access to its Mercury diffusion LLMs — Mercury 2 for reasoning and Mercury Edit 2 for coding at $0.25 per million input and $0.75 per million output tokens — through an OpenAI-compatible REST API with 100 million free tokens for new accounts.

docs.subject: prov_inclusionai
docs.text: InclusionAI is the open-source organization behind Ant Group's artificial general intelligence effort, describing itself as "the series of open-source projects from Ant Group with dedicated efforts to work towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI)".

docs.subject: prov_inclusionai
docs.text: InclusionAI publishes open-weight models for free on Hugging Face — including the Ling, Ming and LLaDA families ranging from about 1B to over 100B parameters — with accompanying code on GitHub, and points users to third-party hosts such as ZenMux and OpenRouter to run them as an API.

docs.subject: prov_intfloat
docs.text: intfloat is the Hugging Face account of Liang Wang, an individual natural language processing researcher at Microsoft Research, rather than a company, and he releases the E5 family of text embedding models under it.

docs.subject: prov_intfloat
docs.text: intfloat publishes free open-weight text and multimodal embedding models on HuggingFace, notably the E5 family (small, base, large, multilingual and instruct variants, plus e5-mistral-7b-instruct and mmE5) along with retrieval and ranking datasets.

docs.subject: prov_kuaishou
docs.text: Kuaishou Technology is a Chinese short-video and live-streaming platform company, listed in Hong Kong, that also develops its own AI models including the Kling video generation family and the KwaiYii large language model.

docs.subject: prov_kuaishou
docs.text: Kuaishou offers its Kling AI video and image generation models as a paid consumer and API product through klingai.com and its KuaiYing editing app.

docs.subject: prov_mancer
docs.text: Mancer is a large language model inferencing service that runs unfiltered LLMs on high-end machines and lets users send whatever prompts they want against them.

docs.subject: prov_mancer
docs.text: Mancer sells hosted inference on its lineup of uncensored LLMs through an unrestricted completion API and prepaid credit packs — some models are free while most are billed per token in credits, with weekly usage-based billing available for business accounts.

docs.subject: prov_meituan
docs.text: Meituan is a Chinese technology company whose LongCat team builds and releases the LongCat family of large language and multimodal models, including the 1.6T-parameter MoE model LongCat-2.0.

docs.subject: prov_meituan
docs.text: Meituan publishes LongCat open weights on HuggingFace — including the 1.6T-parameter MoE LongCat-2.0 and LongCat-Flash, Video, Image and Audio variants — and also sells pay-as-you-go hosted API access through the LongCat platform.

docs.subject: prov_morph
docs.text: Morph is a company that builds specialized fast models for AI coding agents, describing itself as "the model API layer for coding agents".

docs.subject: prov_morph
docs.text: Morph sells a hosted OpenAI-compatible API covering Fast Apply code-edit merging at 10,500 tokens per second, WarpGrep code search, Compact context compression, Reflexes classifiers and embeddings, priced per million tokens with a free tier of 200 requests a month.

docs.subject: prov_nexagi
docs.text: NEX AGI is a Chinese AI research organization that develops the Nex-N1 and Nex-N2 families of agentic mixture-of-experts models.

docs.subject: prov_nexagi
docs.text: NEX AGI distributes its models for paid API use through third-party platforms such as OpenRouter and SiliconFlow, including Nex-N2-Pro, a 397B-parameter MoE with 17B active parameters built on the Qwen3.5 architecture, and the smaller Nex-N2-Mini.

docs.subject: prov_perceptron
docs.text: Perceptron AI Inc. is a foundation model company building "the model layer for physical AI" — multimodal perception models that let machines perceive, reason and act in the real world.

docs.subject: prov_perceptron
docs.text: Perceptron offers a hosted API for its vision-language models, the proprietary Perceptron Mk1 for video understanding and the open-weight Isaac 0.1 and Isaac 0.2 models published on HuggingFace, plus commercial licensing for enterprises.

docs.subject: prov_poolside
docs.text: Poolside is an AI company building open-weight foundation models for software engineering, stating "We're building open-weight foundation models and the systems that refine and improve them."

docs.subject: prov_poolside
docs.text: Poolside offers its Laguna agentic coding models — Laguna S 2.1 at 118B and the on-device Laguna XS 2.1 at 33B — as open weights plus a cloud API, and also distributes them via OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway.

docs.subject: prov_qwen
docs.text: Qwen is the large language model and large multimodal model family and research team of Alibaba Group's Alibaba Cloud, which continuously releases LLMs, LMMs and other AGI-related projects.

docs.subject: prov_qwen
docs.text: Qwen publishes hundreds of open-weight text, multimodal, speech and image models on HuggingFace and GitHub, and sells hosted pay-as-you-go API access to its commercial tiers through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

docs.subject: prov_relace
docs.text: Relace is a Y Combinator-backed company building "models built for coding agents", focused on code merging, retrieval and agent source control rather than general-purpose LLMs.

docs.subject: prov_relace
docs.text: Relace sells a hosted API of small specialized models billed per million tokens — Instant Apply for merging LLM code edits and search and rank models for codebase retrieval — plus agent source control infrastructure and self-hosted deployments.

docs.subject: prov_sakana
docs.text: Sakana AI is a Tokyo-based AI research and development company whose stated mission is "Building Frontier AI in Japan", drawing on nature-inspired ideas of collective intelligence.

docs.subject: prov_sakana
docs.text: Sakana AI offers its own models and products, including the Fugu LLM for orchestrating frontier models on complex tasks, the Japanese-language Namazu LLM, Marlin for on-demand research reports, a translation and proofreading service, and the Sakana Chat interface.

docs.subject: prov_sao10k
docs.text: Sao10K is an individual hobbyist model developer rather than a company, making merges and fine-tunes of open LLMs for creative roleplay and writing, best known for the Euryale, Stheno and Fimbulvetr series.

docs.subject: prov_sao10k
docs.text: Sao10K releases open-weight fine-tunes and merges of other people's base models, mainly Llama 3.x and Qwen2.5, for free on HuggingFace, with several served for a per-token fee by third-party hosts on OpenRouter.

docs.subject: prov_thedrummer
docs.text: TheDrummer (Hugging Face handle "TheDrummer", display name "Drummer") is an individual model fine-tuner rather than a company, publishing over 200 open-weight creative-writing and roleplay fine-tunes such as Rocinante, Cydonia and Skyfall, and funding the work through Ko-fi and Patreon.

docs.subject: prov_thedrummer
docs.text: He runs no hosted API of his own, releasing free downloadable weights and GGUF quantizations of fine-tunes built on other people's base models, which third-party platforms such as OpenRouter then serve.

docs.subject: prov_undi95
docs.text: Undi95 (display name "Undi") is an individual hobbyist fine-tuner and model merger on Hugging Face, not a company, with roughly 293 published models aimed at local roleplay and storytelling use, including ReMM-SLERP-L2-13B, Toppy M 7B and MistralThinker.

docs.subject: prov_undi95
docs.text: Undi95 offers no hosted service or paid product; the output is free open-weight merges and fine-tunes of existing bases such as Llama 2, Mistral and QwQ on HuggingFace, which platforms like OpenRouter host for API access.

docs.subject: prov_xiaomi
docs.text: Xiaomi is a Chinese multinational consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company whose MiMo team builds the company's own large-scale AI models for reasoning, multimodal understanding and agentic use.

docs.subject: prov_xiaomi
docs.text: Xiaomi sells paid API access to its MiMo models — including MiMo-V2.5, MiMo-V2.5-Pro and the MiMo TTS series — through the MiMo open platform, while also publishing open weights for many MiMo models on HuggingFace.

docs.subject: ent_pplx-embed-context-v1-0.6b
docs.text: A 0.6B-parameter contextualized text embedding model from Perplexity, built on diffusion-pretrained Qwen3, producing 1024-dimension int8-quantized vectors. It is intended for document chunks in RAG systems where surrounding context matters, and needs no instruction prefix on indexed text.

docs.subject: ent_pplx-embed-context-v1-4b
docs.text: A 4B-parameter contextualized text embedding model from Perplexity, built on diffusion continued pre-trained Qwen3, producing 2560-dimension int8-quantized vectors. It targets document chunks in RAG systems where surrounding context matters, and lets you embed indexed text directly without maintaining an instruction prefix.

docs.subject: ent_photoroom-image-editing
docs.text: Photoroom's full-featured editing endpoint, which applies edits to an image such as resizing, replacing the background, re-lighting the subject or adding a realistic shadow. It also covers text removal, upscaling and apparel-specific tools like virtual model, flat lay and ghost mannequin.

docs.subject: ent_photoroom-remove-background
docs.text: Photoroom's streamlined endpoint for cases where you only need to remove the background from an image and don't need any additional edits. It takes an image and returns the same image with the background cut out.

docs.subject: ent_pika-2.5
docs.text: Pika's core video generation model, offered on the Pika API for text-to-video and image-to-video, turning photos into dynamic videos at up to 1080p. It is aimed at cinematic shots, short social and ad clips and look-development, with 5 or 10 second outputs.

docs.subject: ent_pika-2.5-keyframe
docs.text: The keyframe (pikaframes) mode of Pika 2.5, which animates between 2 to 5 ordered keyframe images so that consecutive pairs become transitions. An optional prompt guides the motion across those transitions, with 720p or 1080p output.

docs.subject: ent_pika-soundtrack
docs.text: Pika's video-to-audio model, which generates motion-aware sound effects, music, ambience and voiceover that follow what happens on screen. It places each sound at the right moment and keeps the soundtrack coherent through the full video, optionally steered by a text prompt.

docs.subject: ent_pikadditions
docs.text: A Pika video-to-video model that inserts any subject into an existing video. You supply the source footage, a prompt describing what to add and optionally a reference image of the subject, and it composites the addition into the original clip.

docs.subject: ent_pikaffects
docs.text: Pika's effects model, which applies playful physics effects — squish, melt, explode, dissolve and around 50 others — to a still image and turns it into a short animated video. It is aimed at cinematic short-form and social content.

docs.subject: ent_pikaswaps
docs.text: A Pika video-to-video model that swaps subjects or objects in a video while keeping the scene. You give it the footage, a prompt, a region described in free text or as a mask, and optionally a reference image of the replacement subject.

docs.subject: ent_pinecone-rerank-v0
docs.text: Pinecone's hosted reranking model for RAG relevance scoring. It takes a query plus candidate documents and returns a relevance score between 0 and 1 for each query-document pair, reordering results for precision in retrieval-augmented generation.

docs.subject: ent_pinecone-sparse-english-v0
docs.text: Pinecone's sparse English embedding model, based on the DeepImpact architecture, which directly estimates the lexical importance of tokens by leveraging their context. It embeds queries and passages as sparse vectors for lexical and hybrid search, outperforming BM25 on benchmarks.

docs.subject: ent_laguna-m.1
docs.text: Poolside's open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 225B total and 23B activated parameters, built for agentic coding and long-horizon work. It is strongest on coding tasks that require multiple steps, tool use and validation — exploring a codebase, editing files, running tests and iterating on a fix.

docs.subject: ent_qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct
docs.text: An instruction-tuned 3.09B-parameter model from the Qwen2.5-Coder series, the latest series of code-specific Qwen large language models. It brings significant improvements in code generation, code reasoning and code fixing while keeping maths and general strengths, and is aimed at real-world uses such as code agents.

docs.subject: ent_qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct
docs.text: An instruction-tuned 7.61B-parameter model from the Qwen2.5-Coder series of code-specific Qwen large language models. Qwen describes significant improvements in code generation, code reasoning and code fixing, with coding performance comparable to GPT-4o, for real-world uses such as code agents.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507-tee
docs.text: A trusted-execution-environment deployment of Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, a mixture-of-experts causal language model with 235B total and 22B activated parameters that supports only thinking mode. Qwen positions it for deep reasoning in maths, science, coding and logic, with state-of-the-art results among open-source thinking models.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-32b-tee
docs.text: A trusted-execution-environment deployment of Qwen3-32B, a 32.8B-parameter dense model from Qwen's latest generation offering advances in reasoning, instruction-following, agent capabilities and multilingual support. It switches between thinking mode for complex logic, maths and coding and non-thinking mode for efficient general dialogue within a single model.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-4b-instruct-2507
docs.text: An updated 4B-parameter non-thinking causal language model from Qwen, with significant improvements in instruction following, logical reasoning, text comprehension, mathematics, science, coding and tool usage. It supports only non-thinking mode and does not emit think blocks.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-4b-thinking-2507
docs.text: A 4B-parameter Qwen model that runs in thinking mode by default, generating internal reasoning before its final answer. Qwen reports significantly improved performance on reasoning tasks including logical reasoning, mathematics, science, coding and academic benchmarks.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3.5-35b-a3b-base
docs.text: A pre-trained Qwen3.5 foundation model with 35B total and 3B activated parameters, combining Gated Delta Networks with sparse mixture-of-experts and early fusion training on multimodal tokens. Qwen offers it for fine-tuning, in-context learning experiments and other research or development purposes rather than direct chat use.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3.5-397b-a17b-tee
docs.text: A trusted-execution-environment deployment of Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, Qwen's unified vision-language foundation model with 397B total and 17B activated parameters built on Gated Delta Networks plus sparse mixture-of-experts. It handles complex reasoning, coding, visual understanding and agentic tool use across 201 languages.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3.5-9b-base
docs.text: A 9B-parameter pre-trained Qwen3.5 vision-language foundation model offered for fine-tuning, in-context learning experiments and other research or development purposes. It uses early fusion training over multimodal tokens and covers 201 languages and dialects.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3.6-27b-tee
docs.text: A trusted-execution-environment deployment of Qwen3.6-27B, the first open-weight variant of Qwen3.6: a 27B-parameter hybrid multimodal model using Gated DeltaNet and gated attention. Qwen highlights agentic coding, frontend workflows and repository-level reasoning, with thinking mode on by default.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3.8-27b-tee
docs.text: A trusted-execution-environment deployment of Qwen3.8-27B, a dense 27B-parameter vision-language model that Qwen calls the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date. It targets software engineering, agentic reasoning and long professional workflows, with built-in thinking mode by default.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-background-removal
docs.text: Recraft's API endpoint that removes the background of a given image, accepting raster or SVG input and returning the subject on transparency.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-creative-upscale
docs.text: Recraft's creative upscale tool, which enhances a given raster image by boosting resolution with a focus on refining small details and faces.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-crisp-upscale
docs.text: Recraft's crisp upscale tool, which enhances a given raster image by increasing its resolution and making the image sharper and cleaner.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-erase-region
docs.text: Recraft's erase-region endpoint, which removes specified regions of an image using a grayscale mask in which white pixels mark the areas to erase.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-image-to-image
docs.text: Recraft's image-to-image endpoint, which creates images similar to a given image, preserving certain aspects like composition, colour or subject identity while altering others based on the prompt. A strength parameter controls how far the result departs from the source.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-inpainting
docs.text: Recraft's inpainting endpoint, which regenerates specific parts of an image while keeping the rest intact, useful for correcting details, replacing elements or making creative changes. It takes the image, a mask and a prompt.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-replace-background
docs.text: Recraft's replace-background endpoint, which detects the background of an image and modifies it according to a given prompt while keeping the subject.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-v3
docs.text: Recraft's cost-effective earlier-generation image model, which generates faster than the V4 line and emphasises style consistency, precise text positioning and artistic level control.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-v4
docs.text: The previous generation of Recraft's flagship image model, described by Recraft as more opinionated, with strong stylisation that suits creative photoshoot-style work. It is available in standard, Pro and Vector variants.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-v4.1
docs.text: Recraft's latest image generation model, delivering photorealistic results with sharper vector and illustration work and strong results even from short prompts. Recraft positions it for exploration and concepting and for anyone who wants the model to bring something unexpected to the table.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-v4.1-pro
docs.text: The Pro variant of Recraft V4.1, which shares the V4.1 aesthetic but renders at higher resolution for print-ready and large-format work.

docs.subject: ent_recraft-vectorize
docs.text: Recraft's vectorize endpoint, which converts a raster image into an editable SVG vector image.

docs.subject: ent_reducto-deep-extract
docs.text: Reducto's agentic extraction mode, which iteratively refines its output to achieve near-perfect accuracy. Instead of a single pass it verifies results against the source document and re-extracts until a quality threshold is met, aimed at complex documents such as invoices, financial statements and long multi-page tables.

docs.subject: ent_reducto-edit
docs.text: Reducto's document editing endpoint, which fills PDF forms and modifies DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions, returning the updated document.

docs.subject: ent_reducto-extract
docs.text: Reducto's schema-driven extraction endpoint: you pull specific fields into structured JSON using a schema, defining what you need and getting exactly that back from the document.

docs.subject: ent_reducto-parse
docs.text: Reducto's foundational endpoint, which converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables and figures, using layout-aware chunking and agentic OCR across 30+ file types.

docs.subject: ent_reducto-split
docs.text: Reducto's split endpoint, which divides documents into logical sections using natural language descriptions of the sections you want.

docs.subject: ent_reka-core
docs.text: Reka's frontier-class multimodal language model, trained from scratch, which Reka offers for complex tasks requiring sophisticated analysis and for agentic workflows. It accepts text, images, video and audio and is deployable via API, on-premises or on-device.

docs.subject: ent_reka-flash
docs.text: Reka's fast and cost-efficient multimodal chat model for most tasks, accepting text alongside image, video and audio inputs through the Reka chat API.

docs.subject: ent_reka-flash-research
docs.text: Reka Research, exposed as the reka-flash-research model, gives an app access to real-time web results in one call, performing complex multi-step research across the web. Responses carry the answer with inline citations, a full reasoning trace of how the agent searched, and source URLs for every citation.

docs.subject: ent_reka-vision-clip-generation
docs.text: Reka Vision's clip generation, which generates shorter highlight clips from longer videos. Each clip comes back as a rendered video with an AI-generated title, caption, hashtags and an engagement quality score, with control over style, aspect ratio, resolution and subtitles.

docs.subject: ent_reka-vision-image-search
docs.text: Reka Vision's image search, which lets you search through your indexed images using natural language queries and returns matching images ranked by a relevance score.

docs.subject: ent_reka-vision-image-upload
docs.text: Reka Vision's image upload operation, which stores images in your account with optional indexing so they can later be retrieved and searched. It returns an id, URL, indexing status and metadata per image.

docs.subject: ent_reka-vision-qa
docs.text: Reka Vision's video Q&A and tagging, which lets you ask questions about video content and get AI-powered answers with streaming support, and generate tags for videos. It works on indexed videos longer than 30 seconds and supports multi-turn questions.

docs.subject: ent_reka-vision-video-indexing
docs.text: Reka Vision's video upload and indexing, which ingests a video from a file or URL and pre-processes and stores embeddings for it so search and Q&A can run over its content. It returns a video id, URL, indexing status and technical metadata.

docs.subject: ent_reka-vision-video-search
docs.text: Reka Vision's video search, which finds relevant chunks across your uploaded videos from a natural language query by matching visual content, captions and transcripts. Results carry a confidence score, start and end timestamps and playback URLs.

docs.subject: ent_relace-compact
docs.text: Relace's trace compaction model, which compresses long agent traces to only the important details at over 50k tokens per second. It takes an OpenAI- or Anthropic-format message array plus a target token budget and returns a shortened message array, cutting cost for long coding-agent sessions.

docs.subject: ent_relace-rank
docs.text: Relace's code reranker, which given a user request and a codebase retrieves only the files relevant to implementing that request. It returns files ranked by a relevance score between 0 and 1, filtered to a caller-supplied token limit, and was trained on hundreds of thousands of query and code pairs.

docs.subject: ent_resemble-detect
docs.text: Resemble AI's real-time multimodal deepfake detection system, built to stop deepfakes before they cause damage. It takes audio, video and image files through an API and returns a detection verdict with forensic detail in under 300 milliseconds.

docs.subject: ent_resemble-identity
docs.text: Resemble AI's biometric verification product, which authenticates individuals by voice and likeness matching. It enrols a speaker from a short voice sample and then verifies later attempts against that identity across applications.

docs.subject: ent_resemble-intelligence
docs.text: Resemble AI's explainability layer over Detect, which turns a detection verdict into human-readable forensic analysis identifying which artifacts contribute to scores and why. It produces audit-ready reports in real time for compliance teams and legal reviewers.

docs.subject: ent_resemble-watermarker
docs.text: Resemble AI's watermarking product, which embeds imperceptible signals into audio, image, video and text to prove authenticity and protect IP. The watermarks survive compression and transformation and can be detected later to confirm provenance.

docs.subject: ent_rev-language-id
docs.text: Rev AI's Language Identification API, which provides additional speech insights by identifying the spoken language in an audio file. It returns a list of possible languages ranked by a confidence score between 0 and 1.

docs.subject: ent_reverb
docs.text: Rev AI's default machine transcriber, powered by the Reverb ASR model, which Rev calls its latest, most advanced ASR model with a 25-30% relative improvement in accuracy. It transcribes English audio submitted to the speech-to-text API.

docs.subject: ent_reverb-turbo
docs.text: Rev AI's low-cost transcription option, requested as the low_cost transcriber and served by the Reverb Turbo model, a quantised, speed- and memory-oriented version of Reverb ASR. Rev deprecated it on 28 July 2026 in favour of the standard machine transcriber.

docs.subject: ent_whisper-fusion
docs.text: A Whisper-based transcriber option in Rev AI's asynchronous speech-to-text API, offering better support for rare words. Rev deprecated it on 20 August 2026 and recommends the default transcriber instead.

docs.subject: ent_coda
docs.text: Rime's flagship text-to-speech model, combining an LLM backbone with a dedicated speech inference engine trained on full-duplex conversational data. It covers nine languages, emits word-level timestamps for text-audio alignment and interruption handling, and is Rime's recommended starting point for new applications.

docs.subject: ent_mist-v3
docs.text: Rime's ultra-low-latency text-to-speech model for real-time systems and voice agents, with roughly 37 ms time to first audio in Rime's benchmarking. It offers 78 voices across English, French, German and Spanish and supports custom pauses.

docs.subject: ent_act-two
docs.text: Runway's character performance model: you supply a driving performance video of someone acting out a scene plus a character image or video, and Act-Two transfers the movement, expressions, audio and gestures onto that character.

docs.subject: ent_aleph-2
docs.text: Runway's precise video editing model, which takes an existing video plus text or image direction and returns an edited video. It matches input resolution, handles clips up to about 30 seconds and pairs with Gen-4.5 for professional output formats such as ProRes and 10-bit SDR.

docs.subject: ent_gen-4-image
docs.text: Runway's Gen-4 image model, which generates images from a text prompt and up to three reference images, giving control over consistent characters and subjects across lighting, locations and treatments.

docs.subject: ent_gen-4-image-turbo
docs.text: The faster, cheaper variant of Runway's Gen-4 Image model, generating images from text plus reference images at roughly 2.5x the speed of Gen-4 Image.

docs.subject: ent_gen-4-turbo
docs.text: Runway's fast Gen-4 video model, optimised for image-to-video: it animates a supplied still image into a video clip.

docs.subject: ent_gen-4.5
docs.text: Runway's flagship video generation model, offering text-to-video and image-to-video with high visual fidelity, cinematic realism and precise creative control. It supports professional delivery formats including ProRes, PNG sequences, 10-bit SDR and true HDR with BT.2020 grading.

docs.subject: ent_gwm1-avatars
docs.text: Runway's real-time conversational avatars, powered by its GWM-1 general world model. From a single image it generates an expressive digital persona — photorealistic or animated, human or non-human — with control over voice, personality, knowledge and actions, which then holds live conversations as speaking video.

docs.subject: ent_ruby
docs.text: Runway's enhancement model that converts SDR video up to 16-bit HDR, outputting HDR10, HLG, ProRes or OpenEXR sequences. It works on uploaded or generated video clips.

docs.subject: ent_runway-ad-localization
docs.text: A Runway API recipe that localizes an ad image for a target language while preserving the visual creative, swapping the copy without redoing the design.

docs.subject: ent_runway-multi-shot-video
docs.text: A Runway API recipe that generates multi-shot videos that cut between scenes, assembling a sequence of shots from scene descriptions or reference material into one narrative clip.

docs.subject: ent_soundraw
docs.text: SOUNDRAW is an AI music generator that lets creators build royalty-free tracks by choosing genre, mood, length and instrumentation, then customising the arrangement. Its models are trained only on music produced in-house, and outputs are downloadable as MP3, WAV or separated stems and licensed for commercial use.

docs.subject: ent_fugu
docs.text: Sakana AI's multi-agent system delivered as a single model API, which dynamically orchestrates a diverse pool of powerful models rather than following a predetermined workflow. It targets coding, reasoning and quality-critical multi-step work, balancing performance against low latency in the base tier.

docs.subject: ent_fugu-cyber
docs.text: The cybersecurity-specialised variant of Sakana AI's Fugu multi-agent system, which brings model orchestration to security analysis, vulnerability research and threat investigation where depth and precision matter.

docs.subject: ent_namazu-code-execution
docs.text: A built-in tool of Sakana AI's Namazu model that executes Python code in a sandboxed environment with file access, returning generated files as download URLs valid for one hour. The model calls it autonomously inside its agentic loop, which suits data analysis and visualisation tasks.

docs.subject: ent_namazu-web-search
docs.text: A built-in tool of Sakana AI's Namazu model that lets it search the web and retrieve ranked results with snippets, giving the model real-time information for current events and factual queries. The model invokes it autonomously within its agentic loop.

docs.subject: ent_melia-1
docs.text: Speechmatics' multilingual speech-to-text model with code-switching across 56+ languages. Speechmatics recommends it for audio that contains more than one language, including speakers who switch language mid-conversation, and it does not require you to select a language pack.

docs.subject: ent_speechmatics-enhanced
docs.text: Speechmatics' highest-accuracy speech-to-text operating point for single-language audio, available in batch and realtime. Speechmatics suggests it for demanding work such as medical, legal and subtitling, with an Enhanced Medical variant for healthcare terminology.

docs.subject: ent_speechmatics-standard
docs.text: Speechmatics' faster speech-to-text operating point, offering high accuracy while prioritising speed. Speechmatics advises using Standard when throughput or latency matter more than maximum accuracy, such as archival transcription, content indexing or large-scale captioning.

docs.subject: ent_speechmatics-tts
docs.text: Speechmatics' text-to-speech API, which transforms text into natural sounding speech using a low latency API. It offers UK and US English voices and streams 16 kHz 16-bit mono WAV or raw PCM audio, with first chunks typically arriving in under 200 milliseconds.

docs.subject: ent_conservative-upscaler
docs.text: Stability AI's Conservative Upscaler, which takes images between 64x64 and 1 megapixel and upscales them roughly 20-40x up to a 4 megapixel output with minimal alteration to the original. Stability says it minimises changes and should not be used to reimagine an image.

docs.subject: ent_creative-upscaler
docs.text: Stability AI's Creative Upscaler, an asynchronous service that upscales highly degraded images below 1 megapixel all the way to 4K with a creative twist, reimagining detail under a creativity control. Stability notes it is not for photos of 1MP or above because it performs heavy reimagining.

docs.subject: ent_fast-upscaler
docs.text: Stability AI's Fast Upscaler, which enhances image resolution by 4x using predictive and generative AI. It is a lightweight service processing in about a second, aimed at improving compressed images for social posts and similar uses.

docs.subject: ent_sd-3.5-flash
docs.text: A distilled version of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium that generates high-quality images in a 4-step process instead of 40, making it faster than SD 3.5 Medium. It is served through Stability's text-to-image and image-to-image API at 1 megapixel output.

docs.subject: ent_sd-3.5-large
docs.text: Stability AI's 8-billion-parameter base image model, which it calls the most powerful in the Stable Diffusion family thanks to superior quality and prompt adherence. It is intended for professional use cases at 1 megapixel resolution.

docs.subject: ent_sd-3.5-large-turbo
docs.text: A distilled version of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large that generates high-quality images with exceptional prompt adherence in just 4 steps, making it considerably faster than SD 3.5 Large.

docs.subject: ent_sd-3.5-medium
docs.text: Stability AI's 2.5-billion-parameter base image model, which delivers an optimal balance between prompt accuracy and image quality, making it an efficient choice for fast high-performance image generation.

docs.subject: ent_stable-audio-2.5
docs.text: Stability AI's audio generation model capable of producing up to 3-minute, 44.1 kHz stereo compositions. It supports text-to-audio, audio-to-audio and audio-inpaint workflows, letting creators upload a sound and transform it into new instruments, styles or genres via natural language prompts, and was trained on licensed data.

docs.subject: ent_stable-audio-3.0
docs.text: Stability AI's most advanced audio generation model, capable of generating up to 6-minute, 44.1 kHz stereo compositions. It supports text-to-audio, audio-to-audio and audio-inpaint workflows and is aimed at music production, cinematic sound design and remixing; it was trained on licensed data.

docs.subject: ent_stable-fast-3d
docs.text: Stability AI's 3D service that generates high-quality 3D assets from a single 2D input image. The output is a binary glTF (GLB) asset containing JSON, buffers and images.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-control-sketch
docs.text: Stability AI's Sketch control service, which upgrades rough hand-drawn sketches to refined outputs with precise control. For non-sketch images it allows detailed manipulation of the final appearance by leveraging the contour lines and edges within the image.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-control-structure
docs.text: Stability AI's Structure control service, which generates images while maintaining the structure of an input image. Stability calls it especially valuable for advanced content creation such as recreating scenes or rendering characters from models.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-control-style
docs.text: Stability AI's Style Guide control service, which extracts stylistic elements from an input control image and uses them to guide the creation of an output image based on the prompt, yielding a new image in the same style as the control image.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-control-style-transfer
docs.text: Stability AI's Style Transfer service, which applies visual characteristics from reference style images to target images. Unlike Style Guide it transforms existing content while preserving the original composition, helping create consistent content across multiple assets.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-core
docs.text: Stability AI's primary text-to-image service, optimised for fast and affordable generation and described as the best quality achievable at high speed with no prompt engineering required. It is the next-generation model following Stable Diffusion XL and outputs 1.5 megapixel images.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-erase-object
docs.text: Stability AI's Erase service, which removes unwanted objects — such as blemishes on portraits or items on desks — using image masks supplied explicitly or derived from the image's alpha channel.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-inpaint
docs.text: Stability AI's Inpaint service, which modifies images by filling in or replacing specified areas with new content based on the content of a mask image, guided by a prompt.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-outpaint
docs.text: Stability AI's Outpaint service, which inserts additional content in an image to fill in the space in any direction, allowing you to zoom out of an image.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-remove-background
docs.text: Stability AI's Remove Background service, which accurately segments the foreground from an image and removes the background.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-replace-background-and-relight
docs.text: Stability AI's asynchronous edit service that lets users swap backgrounds with AI-generated or uploaded images while adjusting lighting to match the subject. It covers background replacement and generation, relighting under- or over-exposed images, and control of light reference, direction and strength, aimed at e-commerce, real estate and photography.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-search-and-recolor
docs.text: Stability AI's Search and Recolor service, a derivative of inpaint that changes the colour of a specific object in an image using a prompt. It automatically segments the object and recolours it using the colours requested in the prompt.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-search-and-replace
docs.text: Stability AI's Search and Replace service, similar to inpaint but driven by a prompt instead of a mask: it automatically segments the named object and replaces it with the object requested in the prompt.

docs.subject: ent_stable-image-ultra
docs.text: Stability AI's most advanced text-to-image service, based on Stable Diffusion 3.5, producing the highest quality photorealistic outputs for professional print media and large-format applications. Stability highlights its typography, complex compositions, dynamic lighting and overall cohesion, at 1 megapixel output.

docs.subject: ent_stable-point-aware-3d
docs.text: Stability AI's SPAR3D service, which makes real-time edits and creates the complete structure of a 3D object from a single image in a few seconds. It combines point-cloud diffusion with mesh regression to improve detail on the unseen back regions, and unlike Stable Fast 3D it allows editing of backside information.

docs.subject: ent_steel-session
docs.text: A cloud browser instance from Steel, a headless browser API for AI engineers, controlled over API or the Python/Node SDKs. A session runs JavaScript, keeps login state through persistent cookies, and returns page data as cleaned HTML, markdown, PDFs or screenshots, with live viewing and session replay for debugging.

docs.subject: ent_step-1o-audio
docs.text: StepFun's mature, production-tested end-to-end speech model, which StepFun describes as the stable, battle-tested option. It supports multiple preset voice styles and tool calling and is intended for building basic voice interaction and routine content-generation scenarios.

docs.subject: ent_step-1o-turbo-vision
docs.text: StepFun's recommended vision model, with strong image and video understanding, fast output speed and a 32K context. It accepts text, images and video and generates text, and is stronger on maths and code than step-1o-vision-32k while being smaller and faster.

docs.subject: ent_step-2x-large
docs.text: StepFun's text-to-image generation model, which turns text descriptions into high-quality images with realistic rendering and strong Chinese and English text rendering inside the picture.

docs.subject: ent_step-asr
docs.text: StepFun's automatic speech recognition model, supporting real-time and offline recognition of Chinese, English and dialects. It is aimed at speech transcription, meeting minutes, customer-service quality checks and voice search.

docs.subject: ent_step-asr-1.1
docs.text: An updated version of StepFun's speech recognition model for transcribing uploaded audio files into text, serving the same transcription, meeting-record and quality-inspection use cases as step-asr.

docs.subject: ent_step-asr-1.1-stream
docs.text: The streaming variant of StepFun's step-asr-1.1, which recognises audio in real time as it arrives and returns text continuously, for scenarios that need live speech input and immediate transcription.

docs.subject: ent_step-audio-2
docs.text: StepFun's end-to-end speech model with broad auditory understanding across Mandarin, dialects, English and Japanese. It supports voice cloning from an audio sample, understands environmental sounds, paralinguistic cues and emotion, and has native tool calling and web search.

docs.subject: ent_step-audio-r1.5
docs.text: StepFun's reasoning-oriented end-to-end speech model, an upgrade of R1.1 built for deep sound understanding: it thinks while speaking, performs deep inference and keeps interaction natural, with reinforcement learning used to improve long-form dialogue.

docs.subject: ent_step-image-edit-2
docs.text: StepFun's lightweight unified image model, which supports both text-to-image generation and image editing in one system. Edits take only one to two seconds, making it suited to real-time interactive workflows.

docs.subject: ent_step-tts-2
docs.text: The upgraded version of StepFun's text-to-speech model, emphasising controllability of emotion and style with 11 emotions, 17 styles and 3 languages under precise control. It returns synthesised audio in formats such as wav, mp3, flac and opus.

docs.subject: ent_step-tts-mini
docs.text: StepFun's compact text-to-speech model with controllable emotion and style — 11 emotions, 7 styles and 3 languages — accepting up to 1000 characters per request and returning wav, mp3, flac or opus audio.

docs.subject: ent_stepaudio-2-asr-pro
docs.text: StepFun's high-accuracy speech recognition model in the StepAudio 2 family, a 32B-parameter ASR model for transcribing audio to text.

docs.subject: ent_stepaudio-2.5-asr
docs.text: StepFun's next-generation flagship ASR model, a 4B-parameter model with a Multi-Token Prediction architecture that can transcribe five minutes of audio in under a second. It supports timestamps, speaker identification, dual-channel audio and optional text normalisation.

docs.subject: ent_stepaudio-2.5-asr-stream
docs.text: The WebSocket streaming variant of StepFun's StepAudio 2.5 ASR, taking a real-time bidirectional audio stream and returning accumulating text with in-flight correction and character-level timestamps.

docs.subject: ent_scribe-v2
docs.text: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 is a speech-to-text model: the Speech to Text API "turns spoken audio into text with state of the art accuracy", offering accurate transcription in 90+ languages, keyterm prompting, entity detection and audio tagging.

docs.subject: ent_scribe-v2
docs.text: Audio or video file (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, AIFF, M4A, WebM; MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, MPEG, FLV, 3GPP). "Files up to 3 GB in size are supported", up to 10 hours duration.

docs.subject: ent_scribe-v2
docs.text: Scribe v2 (batch, 1,000 keyterms) and Scribe v2 Realtime with "low latency (~150ms)" and 50 keyterms.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-v3
docs.text: ElevenLabs text-to-speech "turns text into lifelike audio with nuanced intonation, pacing and emotional awareness"; Eleven v3 is "Our most emotionally rich, expressive speech synthesis model", Multilingual v2 a "Lifelike, consistent quality speech synthesis model".

docs.subject: ent_eleven-v3
docs.text: Text content plus a voice selected from the voice library; Eleven v3 has a 5,000 character limit and 70+ languages, Multilingual v2 a 10,000 character limit and 29 languages.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-v3
docs.text: Audio in multiple formats including MP3 (22.05kHz-44.1kHz), PCM (S16LE) (16kHz-44.1kHz), μ-law and Opus.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-flash
docs.text: Flash v2.5 is ElevenLabs' "fast, affordable speech synthesis model" for latency-sensitive text-to-speech, with ultra-low latency (~75ms), 32 languages, a 40,000 character limit and "50% lower price per character".

docs.subject: ent_eleven-flash
docs.text: Text content plus a voice selection; up to 40,000 characters per request.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-flash
docs.text: Audio in MP3, PCM (S16LE), μ-law and Opus formats.

docs.subject: ent_sonic
docs.text: Cartesia's original Sonic real-time text-to-speech model, now listed under Older TTS Models: its two late-2024 snapshots are "marked as sunsetted and no longer in active use", superseded by later Sonic releases.

docs.subject: ent_sonic
docs.text: Sunsetted; the documentation directs users to migrate to Sonic 3.5.

docs.subject: ent_sonic-2
docs.text: Cartesia Sonic 2, an earlier-generation text-to-speech model for converting transcripts into speech; "sonic-2 and all sonic-2-* snapshots will stop working after October 20, 2026."

docs.subject: ent_sonic-2
docs.text: The most recent snapshot sonic-2-2025-06-11 supports 8 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

docs.subject: ent_sonic-3
docs.text: Cartesia Sonic 3 is a text-to-speech model, the most recent of the older Sonic line (latest snapshot sonic-3-2026-01-12, stable, 43 languages); Cartesia recommends Sonic 3.5 "for best results, most languages, and naturalness".

docs.subject: ent_sonic-3
docs.text: TTS request with required model_id, transcript, voice and output_format, plus optional language/locale, normalization, pronunciation_dict_id and generation_config for volume, speed and emotion.

docs.subject: ent_sonic-3
docs.text: "Audio bytes" with content type "audio/*", returned as binary data in WAV, MP3 or RAW.

docs.subject: ent_nova-3
docs.text: Deepgram Nova-3 is a speech-to-text model that "represents a significant leap forward in speech AI technology", offering real-time multilingual conversation transcription, domain-specific terminology comprehension and optional personal information redaction.

docs.subject: ent_nova-3
docs.text: Audio submitted to the Deepgram API, for streaming or batch processing.

docs.subject: ent_nova-3
docs.text: Text transcriptions; the page cites "a 54.2% reduction in word error rate (WER) for streaming and 47.4% for batch processing compared to competitors".

docs.subject: ent_aura-2
docs.text: Deepgram Aura-2 is a text-to-speech API with a portfolio of voices for converting written content into natural-sounding audio, used in customer service systems, IVR platforms and content narration.

docs.subject: ent_aura-2
docs.text: Text, with a voice chosen via the model naming format [modelname]-[voicename]-[language], e.g. "model=aura-2-thalia-en".

docs.subject: ent_aura-2
docs.text: Synthesized speech audio; the API curl example writes a WAV file (--output outputfile_voice_model.wav).

docs.subject: ent_aura-2
docs.text: "Deepgram's Aura text-to-speech supports the following languages" — English (American, British, Australian, Irish, Filipino accents), Spanish variants, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Japanese; 40+ English voices.

docs.subject: ent_kokoro
docs.text: "Kokoro is an open-weight TTS model with 82 million parameters." Despite its lightweight architecture it "delivers comparable quality to larger models while being significantly faster and more cost-efficient".

docs.subject: ent_kokoro
docs.text: Text (processed through phoneme labels) plus a voice chosen from 54 voices across 8 languages.

docs.subject: ent_kokoro
docs.text: StyleTTS 2 combined with ISTFTNet, "Decoder only: no diffusion, no encoder release"; Apache 2.0 license; "Kokoro was trained exclusively on permissive/non-copyrighted audio data".

docs.subject: ent_orpheus-3b
docs.text: Orpheus 3B is a "Llama-based Speech-LLM designed for high-quality, empathetic text-to-speech generation", with "Natural intonation, emotion, and rhythm", zero-shot voice cloning and tag-based control of speech and emotion.

docs.subject: ent_orpheus-3b
docs.text: Text prompts, with simple tags to control speech and emotion characteristics; English.

docs.subject: ent_orpheus-3b
docs.text: Synthesized speech audio, with "~200ms streaming latency for realtime applications, reducible to ~100ms with input streaming".

docs.subject: ent_multilingual-e5-large
docs.text: multilingual-e5-large-instruct is a multilingual text-embedding model built on xlm-roberta-large for retrieval, similarity and related tasks; each query carries a one-sentence instruction while retrieval documents need none.

docs.subject: ent_multilingual-e5-large
docs.text: L2-normalized embedding vectors produced by average pooling; "24 layers and the embedding size is 1024". Cosine similarity scores distribute around 0.7 to 1.0 due to InfoNCE temperature 0.01.

docs.subject: ent_multilingual-e5-large
docs.text: "supports 100 languages from xlm-roberta, but low-resource languages may see performance degradation."

docs.subject: ent_multilingual-e5-small
docs.text: multilingual-e5-small is a compact multilingual text-embedding model: "This model has 12 layers and the embedding size is 384", initialized from microsoft/Multilingual-MiniLM-L12-H384, for retrieval, similarity, clustering and classification.

docs.subject: ent_multilingual-e5-small
docs.text: Text where "Each input text should start with "query: " or "passage: ", even for non-English texts." Use both for asymmetric retrieval, "query: " alone for symmetric tasks or feature extraction. "Long texts will be truncated to at most 512 tokens."

docs.subject: ent_juggernaut-pro-flux
docs.text: Juggernaut Pro Flux is RunDiffusion's flagship text-to-image model in the Juggernaut FLUX series: it "boosts realism, especially in people, surpassing Flux 1.1 Pro and other flagship models in this category".

docs.subject: ent_juggernaut-pro-flux
docs.text: Generated image, with "enhanced sharpness, colors, skin tone, reduced blur, and overall improved visual aesthetics"; a drop-in replacement for Flux 1.1 Pro.

docs.subject: ent_juggernaut-lightning-flux
docs.text: Juggernaut Lightning Flux is RunDiffusion's speed-oriented text-to-image model: "Using the power of Flux Schnell, this mode is blazing fast and insanely powerful", with some providers generating it in under 300ms.

docs.subject: ent_juggernaut-lightning-flux
docs.text: Generated image; a drop-in replacement for Flux Schnell trained non-destructively on the Flux architecture.

docs.subject: ent_p-image-ideogram
docs.text: P-Image-Ideogram is Pruna AI's text-to-image model "Built in collaboration with Ideogram": "Fast. Affordable. Beautiful. State-of-the-art AI image in less than one second."

docs.subject: ent_p-image-ideogram
docs.text: Text prompt, plus a choice of four thinking modes: Very Low ($0.003, ~0.4s), Low ($0.0075, ~0.8s), Medium ($0.010, ~1.3s), High ($0.015, ~1.3s).

docs.subject: ent_p-image-ideogram
docs.text: Generated images at 1K and 2K resolution; "P-Image-Ideogram delivers quality on par with SoTA models, but it is cheaper and faster".

docs.subject: ent_web-search
docs.text: A web search API for AI applications: it executes a search query against the live web and returns ranked, LLM-ready results, optionally with an LLM-generated short answer.

docs.subject: ent_web-search
docs.text: "The search query to execute", plus controls such as search depth (latency vs. relevance tradeoff, from advanced to ultra-fast), max_results (0-20, default 5) and topic (general or news).

docs.subject: ent_web-search
docs.text: An array of results, each with "The title of the search result", "The URL of the search result", "A short description of the search result" and "The relevance score of the search result"; optionally "A short answer to the user's query, generated by an LLM", plus response time and credits used.

docs.subject: ent_page-render
docs.text: A URL-to-content extraction API: given web addresses it retrieves the raw page content in clean, model-ready form, so an application can read pages it already knows the URLs of.

docs.subject: ent_page-render
docs.text: "A list of URLs to extract content from", plus extract_depth (basic or advanced) and format ("markdown returns content in markdown format. text returns plain text and may increase latency.").

docs.subject: ent_page-render
docs.text: raw_content, "The full content extracted from the page"; optional extracted image URLs; and failed_results, "A list of URLs that could not be processed" with an error message each.

docs.subject: ent_page-render
docs.text: Second vendor, same service kind: an endpoint that "returns clean, structured content from any URL, handling JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs, and complex layouts automatically", and can crawl linked subpages in one request.

docs.subject: ent_page-render
docs.text: "You pass in URLs and get back full page text, targeted highlights, LLM-generated summaries, or all three" — text mode returns "Full page content as clean markdown".

docs.subject: ent_web-answer
docs.text: A web-grounded answer endpoint: it "performs a search based on the query and generates either a direct answer or a detailed summary with citations", so an application gets a sourced answer rather than a result list.

docs.subject: ent_web-answer
docs.text: query — "Natural-language question or instructions for the request"; optional text ("If true, returns full page text with default settings") and stream, where "the response is returned as a server-sent events (SSE) stream".

docs.subject: ent_web-answer
docs.text: An answer (direct for specific queries, a detailed summary for open-ended ones) plus citations — "Search results used to generate the answer", with title, URL, publication date, author and source text when requested.

docs.subject: ent_research-agent
docs.text: An autonomous web-research agent endpoint: "an async, usage-based endpoint for high-compute tasks like list building, enrichment, and deep research" that "handles complex reasoning and can return many structured output fields".

docs.subject: ent_research-agent
docs.text: Open-ended natural-language instructions for a multi-step research, list-building or enrichment workflow, optionally with a schema for the desired structured output; runs can continue from a previous run.

docs.subject: ent_research-agent
docs.text: "Each run can return a natural-language answer, schema-validated JSON, field-level grounding, metadata, and a cost breakdown. You can retrieve completed runs later, list past runs, replay events, or continue from a previous run."

docs.subject: ent_research-agent
docs.text: Asynchronous: use it "when a workflow needs more than a single search or extraction call"; for simpler low-latency needs the docs point to the Search API instead.

docs.subject: ent_voice-caller
docs.text: A voice-agent platform that "makes it easy to build voice agents that can make and receive phone calls", so an assistant can answer inbound calls and place outbound calls autonomously.

docs.subject: ent_voice-caller
docs.text: An assistant configuration (system prompt plus a bundled transcriber, model and voice, offered as "Model Intelligence presets"), a phone number, and the live caller's speech audio.

docs.subject: ent_voice-caller
docs.text: A live phone conversation in synthesized voice: for inbound, "Your assistant will pick up and start the conversation"; for outbound, "Your assistant will call the specified number immediately".

docs.subject: ent_support-resolver
docs.text: An AI customer-support agent billed per resolved outcome: it "provides fast, accurate answers to customers 24/7 via live chat, email, SMS, WhatsApp, social and more", and you "Only pay when Fin resolves the issue end to end".

docs.subject: ent_support-resolver
docs.text: Incoming customer conversations across channels — "tickets, cases, emails, live chat, WhatsApp, SMS, and more" — against your configured knowledge and procedures.

docs.subject: ent_support-resolver
docs.text: Answers to the customer plus a billable outcome. Outcomes: Resolution ($0.99) — "No further help is requested after Fin's last answer"; Procedure handoff ($0.99); Disqualification ($0.99) — "Fin determines that a prospect doesn't match your qualification criteria"; Qualification ($9.99).

docs.subject: ent_support-resolver
docs.text: "You're not charged when a conversation is simply passed to your team without an outcome." 50-outcome monthly minimum when integrated with other helpdesks.

docs.subject: ent_code-execution
docs.text: A sandboxed code-execution tool for models: Code Interpreter "adds the capability to safely execute code in an isolated container", and is "practical to draw graphs, data analysis, mathematical operations, code validation, and much more".

docs.subject: ent_code-execution
docs.text: Code written by the agent, run inside an isolated container as a built-in tool of the agent.

docs.subject: ent_code-execution
docs.text: The executed code plus "The output of the executed code" (code_output) returned with execution metadata.

docs.subject: ent_image-generation
docs.text: An image-generation tool call inside an agent API: "Image Generation is a built-in tool that enables agents to generate images of all kinds and forms", letting a model create images at any point in a conversation.

docs.subject: ent_image-generation
docs.text: A text prompt to the agent, e.g. "Generate an orange cat in an office."

docs.subject: ent_image-generation
docs.text: A tool_file chunk carrying "a unique identifier for the generated file" (file_id), file_name and file_type "which in this case is png"; the image is then downloaded via the files endpoint.

docs.subject: ent_file-search
docs.text: File search over uploaded documents: "The Gemini API enables Retrieval Augmented Generation ("RAG") through the File Search tool", which "imports, chunks, and indexes your data to enable fast retrieval of relevant information based on a provided prompt".

docs.subject: ent_file-search
docs.text: Documents uploaded to a File Search store, plus a query prompt; "This retrieved information is then used as context for the model."

docs.subject: ent_file-search
docs.text: "File search is also able to provide multimodal capabilities with text embeddings supported by gemini-embedding-001, and image/multimodal embedding supported by gemini-embedding-2."

docs.subject: ent_maps-grounding
docs.text: Grounding model answers in Google Maps data: it "connects the generative capabilities of Gemini with the rich, factual, and up-to-date data of Google Maps" and "enables developers to easily incorporate location-aware functionality into their applications".

docs.subject: ent_maps-grounding
docs.text: A user query with geographical context (e.g. "coffee shops near me"), optionally accompanied by the user's latitude and longitude; the tool is off by default and must be enabled in the request.

docs.subject: ent_maps-grounding
docs.text: "a text response with inline annotations linking to Google Maps sources, allowing developers to display citations"; each annotation includes the place name and a URL to the Maps listing.

docs.subject: ent_data-grounding
docs.text: Grounding model answers in your own data: responses are anchored to your organization's sources rather than model training data alone, making them factually current and traceable to authoritative sources.

docs.subject: ent_data-grounding
docs.text: A user prompt plus a configured grounding source: Vertex AI Search (managed enterprise search), RAG-based grounding, Elasticsearch, or a custom search API of your own.

docs.subject: ent_data-grounding
docs.text: A grounded response with citations / grounding metadata referencing the retrieved source information.

docs.subject: ent_embeddings-for-text
docs.text: A text embeddings API that "uses dense vector representations" designed "to better represent the meaning of a piece of text", so you can search for passages that align to a query's meaning rather than word matches.

docs.subject: ent_embeddings-for-text
docs.text: Dense numeric vectors — "gemini-embedding-001, for example, uses 3072-dimensional vectors". "The vectors are normalized, so you can use cosine similarity, dot product, or Euclidean distance to provide the same similarity rankings."

docs.subject: prov_qwen
docs.text: Qwen publishes open-weight text, multimodal and embedding models on Hugging Face and GitHub, and sells hosted pay-as-you-go access to the Qwen-Max, Qwen-Plus and Qwen-Flash tiers through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's official and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

docs.subject: prov_relace
docs.text: Relace is a San Francisco-based, Y Combinator-backed company that builds purpose-built AI models and infrastructure for coding agents, specializing in fast code merging, retrieval and context compression rather than general-purpose LLMs.

docs.subject: prov_relace
docs.text: Relace sells a hosted API of in-house small models billed per million tokens, including Instant Apply for merging LLM code edits at 10,000 tok/s, Compact for context rewriting, relace-search and relace-rank for codebase retrieval, plus Relace Repos agent source control and self-hosted or VPC-isolated deployments.

docs.subject: prov_sakana
docs.text: Sakana AI K.K. is a Tokyo-based AI research and development company building frontier AI in Japan, drawing on nature-inspired ideas of collective intelligence across research, applied solutions for finance, defense and public infrastructure, and consumer AI products.

docs.subject: prov_sao10k
docs.text: Sao10K is an individual hobbyist model developer, not a company, who makes merges and fine-tunes of open LLMs for creative roleplay and writing, best known for the Euryale, Stheno and Fimbulvetr series.

docs.subject: prov_sao10k
docs.text: Sao10K releases open-weight fine-tunes and merges of other people's base models (mainly Llama 3/3.1/3.3 and Qwen2.5) for free on Hugging Face, with several of them served for a per-token fee by third-party hosts on OpenRouter and supported by Ko-fi and Patreon donations.

docs.subject: ent_mai-image-2.5
docs.text: A Microsoft AI diffusion-based text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing model that creates high-quality images from natural language prompts and makes precise, surgical edits to existing images while preserving visual consistency.

docs.subject: ent_mai-image-2.5-flash
docs.text: A text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing model optimized to produce diverse, coherent images across creative and design scenarios such as concept visualization, creative content generation, image editing workflows, and production design.

docs.subject: ent_mai-image-2.5-pro
docs.text: A diffusion-based text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing model designed for complex compositions, excelling at object and character consistency, material and physical-property accuracy, and spatial and geometric reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_mai-image-2e
docs.text: A text-to-image generation model that delivers high-quality image generation up to 22% faster and four times more efficient than MAI-Image-2, best suited to high-volume, fast-turnaround work like product imagery and marketing variations.

docs.subject: ent_mai-cyber-1-flash
docs.text: A small, efficient Microsoft in-house model fine-tuned for cybersecurity vulnerability workflows in MDASH, covering discovery, validation, triage, and patching at a fraction of the cost of third-party models.

docs.subject: ent_mai-thinking-1
docs.text: A reasoning model from Microsoft for workloads that depend on multi-step reasoning, such as math, coding, and enterprise scenarios, served through an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API with encrypted chain-of-thought.

docs.subject: ent_mai-ds-r1
docs.text: A DeepSeek-R1 reasoning model post-trained by the Microsoft AI team to improve its responsiveness on blocked topics and its risk profile, while maintaining its reasoning capabilities and competitive performance.

docs.subject: ent_phi-4-mini
docs.text: A lightweight 3.8B-parameter open model built on synthetic data and filtered public websites with a focus on high-quality, reasoning-dense data, generating text responses from chat- or function-calling-formatted prompts.

docs.subject: ent_phi-4-mini-reasoning
docs.text: A lightweight 3.8B-parameter open model built on reasoning-dense synthetic data and further finetuned for more advanced math reasoning, producing step-by-step solutions to mathematical and multi-step logical problems.

docs.subject: ent_phi-4-reasoning
docs.text: A state-of-the-art open-weight reasoning model finetuned from Phi-4 using supervised fine-tuning on chain-of-thought traces plus reinforcement learning; responses contain a reasoning chain-of-thought block followed by a summarization block.

docs.subject: ent_hive-ai-audio-classifier
docs.text: Hive's AI Audio Classifier takes an audio file as input and determines whether or not that audio is AI-generated, so platforms can immediately identify and tag artificial audio clips. It returns confidence scores for the ai_generated and not_ai_generated classes, splitting longer clips into timestamped 10-second segments.

docs.subject: ent_hive-ai-image-deepfake-classifier
docs.text: A Hive endpoint that runs two models over an image to flag artificially created or manipulated media: AI-generated detection returns ai_generated / not_ai_generated plus the likely generator (DALL-E, Midjourney, Sora and other popular AI art generators) and any C2PA metadata, while deepfake detection returns a confidence score for each detected face.

docs.subject: ent_hive-ai-video-detection
docs.text: The video form of Hive's AI-generated content detection: it scans video frames to identify AI-generated and deepfake footage, returning generation and source classifications with confidence scores. Hive positions it for flagging AI-generated content on social platforms, preventing fraud in claims evidence, and limiting misinformation and digital sexual assault.

docs.subject: ent_hive-audio-moderation
docs.text: Hive's speech moderation API, built on top of its speech-to-text and text moderation models, detects undesirable speech inside audio or video. It returns a fully punctuated transcript with per-word confidence and timestamps plus moderation scores for the Sexual, Violence, Hate and Bullying classes.

docs.subject: ent_hive-automl-image-classification
docs.text: Hive AutoML Image Classification lets you train custom image classification models on your own dataset to categorize images and videos, starting from either an Image Classification or a Visual Moderation base model. Typical uses are object classification, brand identification and vision moderation.

docs.subject: ent_hive-automl-text-classification
docs.text: Hive AutoML Text Classification lets you train custom text classification models that predict a category or class for a piece of text content, choosing among general-purpose, moderation and sentiment base models. It is aimed at content moderation, topic labelling and sentiment analysis.

docs.subject: ent_hive-celebrity-recognition
docs.text: Hive's Celebrity Recognition API detects the presence of well-known figures in images, combining face detection and face-similarity models with a continuously updated index of over 50,000 figures. For each detected face it returns a bounding box, the person's name, a confidence score and a category such as politician, athlete, religious leader or celebrity.

docs.subject: ent_hive-contextual-scene-classifier
docs.text: The purpose of Hive's Contextual Scene Classification is to identify the context of visual content, chiefly for content-based ad targeting. For each image or sampled video frame it returns confidence scores across settings, subjects, objects and the IAB Content Taxonomy.

docs.subject: ent_hive-logo-recognition
docs.text: Hive's Logo Recognition model localizes brand logos in images and video, returning a bounding box, the brand classification, a clarity score representing visible identifiability, and the surface the logo appears on (jersey, helmet, stadium sign and so on). Hive describes it as the world's most comprehensive logo model, covering more than 11,000 logos.

docs.subject: ent_hive-object-detection
docs.text: Hive's Object Detection API localizes objects of interest in an image by returning a box that bounds each object plus its type, across 80+ supported classes such as person, car and dog. For video, Hive splits the clip into frames, runs the model on each and recombines the results with timestamps.

docs.subject: ent_hive-ocr
docs.text: Hive's OCR model detects and transcribes each word in an image and also returns semantically organized text blocks in natural reading order, with emoji detection across Apple, Samsung and Google devices. It is used for moderating memes and image-based text, spotting contact details and promotional overlays, and pulling structured metadata out of receipts, forms and screenshots.

docs.subject: ent_hive-ocr-moderation
docs.text: Hive's OCR Moderation is an end-to-end API that provides content moderation for text within images by first extracting all text in the image and passing that information through Hive's text moderation models. It returns text localization, confidence scores across moderation classes, and profanity or pattern matches, and covers twelve languages plus emoji.

docs.subject: ent_hive-speech-to-text
docs.text: Hive's Speech-to-Text model ingests an audio stream and returns each word that was spoken along with a confidence score and timestamp for that word, plus a language classification and a fully punctuated transcript. It supports English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Hindi, German, Arabic and Japanese.

docs.subject: ent_hive-text-moderation
docs.text: Hive's Text Moderation API takes raw text from your content and returns classification scores on a 0-3 severity scale across the sexual, hate, violence, spam and bullying classes, together with profanity and PII pattern matches and language detection. Hive notes the API does not remove content or ban users itself; it returns the data you build your own enforcement logic on.

docs.subject: ent_hive-text-translation
docs.text: Hive's Translation API uses a proprietary deep learning model to translate text between commonly spoken languages, targeting enterprise use cases at scale such as translating user-generated posts and reviews. It takes raw text of up to 512 characters plus source and target language codes and returns the translated text.

docs.subject: ent_hive-vision-language-model
docs.text: The Hive Vision Language Model turns images, or image and text pairs, into plain-language answers and structured JSON in one call, so teams can handle moderation, tagging or detection of subtle elements without stitching together multiple models. Classes are described in the prompt rather than retrained, and Bias Tuning lets teams adjust class weights directly in the prompt.

docs.subject: ent_hive-visual-moderation
docs.text: Hive's Visual Moderation API automatically classifies images and video for sensitive subject matter, returning per-class confidence scores from several model heads (explicit content, weapons, drugs and more) plus timestamps for video. Hive stresses that the API does not remove content or ban users itself, but returns the classification metrics you act on.

docs.subject: ent_google-cloud-translation-nmt
docs.text: The Neural Machine Translation model is Cloud Translation's default translation engine, translating text between supported languages through the Cloud Translation API. It handles plain text and HTML, translating only the text that appears between tags and leaving the HTML tags themselves untouched.

docs.subject: ent_google-translation-llm
docs.text: Translation LLM (TLLM) is Google's state-of-the-art translation model, a large language model that Google says provides the highest available quality of translation, and the model that underpins Cloud Translation's Adaptive Translation. A single request can carry up to 1024 strings.

docs.subject: ent_google-adaptive-translation
docs.text: With adaptive translation you provide the text to translate together with example translations that Cloud Translation uses to tailor its responses, so machine output matches your own style, tone and domain terminology.
