You can pass up to five example pairs inline, or create a dataset from which Cloud Translation automatically selects the five reference sentences most similar to your source sentence.

docs.subject: ent_google-cloud-translation-document
docs.text: Document Translation translates formatted documents such as PDF and DOCX directly, preserving the original formatting and layout in the translated output. It supports DOC/DOCX, PDF, PPT/PPTX and XLS/XLSX, in both online single-file and batch modes, and works with custom models and glossaries.

docs.subject: ent_google-model-armor
docs.text: Model Armor is a Google Cloud service designed to enhance the security and safety of your AI applications by proactively screening LLM prompts and responses. It helps prevent malicious input, verify content safety, protect sensitive data, maintain compliance and enforce AI safety and security policies, covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, harmful content and malicious URLs.

docs.subject: ent_deepl-translate
docs.text: DeepL's text-translation API consists of a single translate endpoint that submits UTF-8 plain text (up to 128 KiB per request) for translation between DeepL's supported languages, returning translations in the order requested. It supports source-language detection, glossaries, formality levels and formatting preservation.

docs.subject: ent_deepl-write
docs.text: The DeepL Write API improves text within a single language rather than translating it: /write/rephrase fixes spelling and grammar and may rewrite sentences for clarity, style or tone, while /write/correct runs a corrections-only pass that fixes spelling and grammar with minimal changes to wording. Writing style and tone parameters steer how the improved text sounds.

docs.subject: ent_deepl-voice-speech-to-text
docs.text: The speech-to-text mode of DeepL's Voice API, which transcribes and translates spoken audio in real time over a WebSocket connection. From one audio stream you receive transcripts in the source language and translations as text in multiple target languages of your choice.

docs.subject: ent_deepl-voice-speech-to-speech
docs.text: The speech-to-speech mode of DeepL's Voice API, which transcribes and translates spoken audio in real time over a WebSocket connection and additionally returns synthesized speech in the target language alongside the translated text.

docs.subject: ent_amazon-bedrock-guardrails
docs.text: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails provides configurable safeguards to help you build safe generative AI applications, detecting and filtering undesirable content and protecting sensitive information in user inputs or model responses. It bundles content filters, denied topics, word filters, sensitive information filters, contextual grounding checks and Automated Reasoning checks, and can be applied during model inference or standalone through the ApplyGuardrail API.

docs.subject: ent_amazon-translate
docs.text: Amazon Translate is a text translation service that uses advanced machine learning technologies to provide high-quality translation on demand. You can use it to translate unstructured text documents or to build applications that work in multiple languages, from company-authored content and interpersonal communications to incoming social and news feeds.

docs.subject: ent_azure-ai-content-safety
docs.text: Azure AI Content Safety is an AI service that detects harmful user-generated and AI-generated content in applications and services, with text and image APIs for spotting sexual, violent, hate and self-harm material at multiple severity levels. It also includes Prompt Shields, groundedness detection, protected material detection and custom categories, and an interactive Content Safety Studio.

docs.subject: ent_llama-text-embed-v2
docs.text: llama-text-embed-v2 is a text embedding model built by NVIDIA on the Llama 3.2 1B architecture, converting text into dense vectors for semantic search and retrieval across 26 languages. It can be returned at 1024, 2048, 768, 512 or 384 dimensions and works with cosine or dot-product similarity.

docs.subject: ent_orpheus-arabic-saudi
docs.text: Orpheus Arabic Saudi is a specialized text-to-speech model developed by Canopy Labs that generates authentic Saudi dialect speech with natural pronunciation and regional nuances. It offers several voices (Abdullah, Fahad, Sultan, Lulwa, Noura, Aisha) and is intended for input text under about 200 characters per request.

docs.subject: ent_musesteamer-air-i2v
docs.text: MuseSteamer-Air-I2V is an image-to-video model developed by Baidu's search team to deliver extreme cost-performance. It quickly generates short videos with clear image quality and coherent motion from a single image, turning a static photo into a moving story.

docs.subject: ent_atom
docs.text: Atom is Argil's AI-avatar video model: you give it a text script and an avatar, and the avatar speaks exactly what you write. Argil recommends it for clear, controlled messaging, in contrast to its prompt-driven VEO option which improvises the scene.

docs.subject: ent_braintrust-score
docs.text: In Braintrust a scorer returns a numeric score between 0 and 1, measuring qualities like factual accuracy, helpfulness or correct formatting. Scorers receive an AI result's input, output, expected value, metadata and trace and can run at span or trace level, so teams can track quality over time, set pass/fail benchmarks and compare outputs.

docs.subject: ent_patronus-small-evaluator
docs.text: The lower-cost tier of Patronus's hosted evaluator API, billed per thousand small evaluator API calls. Patronus evaluators are automated functions that score the quality, safety and performance of your LLM outputs.

docs.subject: ent_patronus-large-evaluator
docs.text: The higher-capability tier of Patronus's hosted evaluator API, billed per thousand large evaluator API calls. Patronus evaluators are automated functions that score the quality, safety and performance of your LLM outputs.

docs.subject: ent_patronus-eval-explanations
docs.text: A separately billed Patronus output: most evaluators also return explanations, human-readable reasoning for why they gave a particular score, so you understand not just what the score is but why your output received it.

docs.subject: ent_langsmith-trace
docs.text: In LangSmith a trace is a collection of runs for a single operation. When one user request makes an agent call a model, run a tool and call the model again, all of those runs belong to the same trace, bound together by a unique trace ID.

docs.subject: ent_confident-ai-llm-evaluation
docs.text: Confident AI is an AI quality platform built for enterprise teams to standardize evals and observability across the organization. Its LLM evaluation side offers 50+ research-backed metrics, multi-turn simulation, human metric alignment and CI/CD regression testing, alongside tracing, drift detection, governance gating and OWASP/NIST-based red teaming.

docs.subject: ent_lingo-localization-engine
docs.text: A Lingo.dev localization engine is a stateful translation API you build and configure on Lingo.dev, instead of sending content to a generic LLM. It combines five layers - LLM model choice per language pair, brand voice, per-locale rules, a glossary of exact term mappings, and AI reviewers - and accumulates glossary, brand voice and translation memory across requests.

docs.subject: ent_lingo-ai-review
docs.text: An AI reviewer run on Lingo.dev: automated evaluation using an independent LLM, performed after each translation. Every reviewer attached to an engine runs on every translation request and works asynchronously, so it never slows the translation response down.

docs.subject: ent_bolt
docs.text: Bolt is an AI-powered builder for websites, web apps and mobile apps: you describe an idea in chat and Bolt turns it into a working product, with database, hosting and domains built into the same platform. It runs entirely in the browser, lets you pick your AI agent, and you own the generated code.

docs.subject: ent_lovable
docs.text: Lovable is a full-stack AI development platform for building, iterating on and deploying web applications using natural language, with real code, security and enterprise governance. It generates complete applications - frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations - as editable code you own and can sync to GitHub or GitLab.

docs.subject: ent_replit-agent
docs.text: Replit Agent is an AI-powered creative partner that turns an idea described in plain language into a working application. Unlike a chatbot that only answers questions, Agent takes action: it sets up your project, creates applications, checks its work and fixes problems along the way, covering web and mobile apps, dashboards, prototypes and documents.

docs.subject: ent_vapi
docs.text: Vapi is the developer platform for building voice AI agents, handling the complex infrastructure so you can focus on creating great voice experiences. It chains speech-to-text, a large language model and text-to-speech so assistants can hold phone conversations for support, lead qualification, scheduling and similar workflows.

docs.subject: ent_bland
docs.text: Bland is an enterprise voice AI platform that automates the calls you thought required a human, covering inbound support, scheduling and identity verification as well as outbound lead qualification, confirmations and follow-ups, and replacing IVR phone trees with natural language. It runs on the customer's own infrastructure rather than routing calls through third parties.

docs.subject: ent_retell
docs.text: Retell is a platform to build, test, deploy and monitor AI voice and chat agents with telephony, prompts, tools and analytics built in. Agents can be assembled in a no-code node-based dashboard or programmatically via APIs and SDKs, with knowledge bases, CRM connectivity, call-center features and post-call analysis.

docs.subject: ent_composer-2.5
docs.text: Composer 2.5 is Cursor's own coding model, which Cursor describes as a substantial improvement in intelligence and behavior over Composer 2: it is better at sustained work on long-running tasks, follows complex instructions more reliably, and is more pleasant to collaborate with. It was trained with reinforcement learning on programming problems and synthetic coding tasks.

docs.subject: ent_v0-mini
docs.text: One of the three v0 agent models Vercel offers for generating and editing app code from a prompt. v0 describes v0 Mini as the fastest and most cost-efficient of the three.

docs.subject: ent_v0-pro
docs.text: One of the three v0 agent models Vercel offers for generating and editing app code from a prompt. v0 describes v0 Pro as offering superior performance for most tasks; it replaced the model previously sold simply as v0 Agent.

docs.subject: ent_v0-max
docs.text: The top tier of the three v0 agent models Vercel offers for generating and editing app code from a prompt. v0 describes v0 Max as maximum intelligence for complex work and best designs; it replaced the Opus option in v0's model picker.

docs.subject: ent_chat-latest-05052026
docs.text: A dated snapshot (5 May 2026) of OpenAI's chat-latest model, the alias that points to the latest Instant model currently used in ChatGPT. OpenAI recommends its numbered GPT models for production API use and offers chat-latest so developers can test the newest ChatGPT chat improvements.

docs.subject: ent_chat-latest-05282026
docs.text: A dated snapshot (28 May 2026) of OpenAI's chat-latest model, the alias that points to the latest Instant model currently used in ChatGPT. OpenAI recommends its numbered GPT models for production API use and offers chat-latest so developers can test the newest ChatGPT chat improvements.

docs.subject: ent_chat-latest-07012026
docs.text: A dated snapshot (1 July 2026) of OpenAI's chat-latest model, the alias that points to the latest Instant model currently used in ChatGPT. OpenAI recommends its numbered GPT models for production API use and offers chat-latest so developers can test the newest ChatGPT chat improvements.

docs.subject: ent_chat-latest-08062026
docs.text: A dated snapshot (6 August 2026) of OpenAI's chat-latest model, the alias that points to the latest Instant model currently used in ChatGPT. OpenAI recommends its numbered GPT models for production API use and offers chat-latest so developers can test the newest ChatGPT chat improvements.

docs.subject: ent_kling-1.0
docs.text: Kling 1.0 (API model kling-v1) is the first-generation Kling video model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It accepts text, image and video input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P, with camera-control and other single-shot generation features.

docs.subject: ent_kling-1.5
docs.text: Kling 1.5 (API model kling-v1-5) is a Kling video generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It accepts text, image and video input and produces 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P; unlike Kling 1.0 and 1.6 it does not support plain text-to-video single-shot generation.

docs.subject: ent_kling-1.6
docs.text: Kling 1.6 (API model kling-v1-6) is a Kling video generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It accepts text, image and video input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P.

docs.subject: ent_kling-2.0-master
docs.text: Kling 2.0 Master (API model kling-v2-master) is the flagship model of Kling's 2.0 video generation line on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text or image input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 1080P.

docs.subject: ent_kling-2.5-turbo-pro
docs.text: Kling 2.5 Turbo (API model kling-v2-5-turbo, called in pro mode) is a Kling video model that Kuaishou sums up as max creativity with exceptional value. It takes text or image input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-1.0
docs.text: Kling Image 1.0 (API model kling-v1) is the first-generation image model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text and image input and generates 1K images in aspect ratios from 21:9 through 1:1 to 9:16.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-1.5
docs.text: Kling Image 1.5 (API model kling-v1-5) is an image generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text and image input and generates 1K images across the platform's eight supported aspect ratios.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-2.0
docs.text: Kling Image 2.0 (API model kling-v2) is an image generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text and image input and generates images at 1K or 2K resolution across the platform's eight supported aspect ratios.

docs.subject: ent_seed-1.6-lite
docs.text: Doubao-Seed-1.6-lite is ByteDance's compact deep-thinking model on Volcengine Ark, launched as the strongest small-size reasoning model in the Seed 1.6 line with a large speed-up in inference over doubao-seed-1-6.

docs.subject: ent_seed-1.6-vision
docs.text: Doubao-Seed-1.6-vision is Doubao's visual thinking model, offering stronger general multimodal understanding and reasoning than doubao-1-5-vision-pro in scenarios such as education, image moderation, inspection and security, and AI search Q&A. It supports deep thinking, GUI task handling, tool calling and structured output.

docs.subject: ent_seed-character
docs.text: Doubao-Seed-character is ByteDance's role-play model for entertainment scenarios, with strengthened plot reasoning, dialogue pacing and emotional progression, plus human-like natural chat, thinking, and multimodal understanding of video, images and stickers. It can proactively start a conversation and reply in context, and supports format following and function/tool calling.

docs.subject: ent_seed-code
docs.text: Doubao-Seed-code is the programming model in ByteDance's Doubao Seed line on Volcengine Ark: a deep-thinking model with enhanced coding capability that supports both thinking and non-thinking modes alongside multimodal understanding and tool calling.

docs.subject: ent_seed-evolving
docs.text: Seed-Evolving is the Seed-series model built for Agent and Coding scenarios, with complex task orchestration, long-horizon planning, code generation and tool-calling abilities. It ships on a dynamic iteration mechanism with at least one new version a week, and is always called through the single model ID doubao-seed-evolving so you get the latest version without switching endpoints.

docs.subject: ent_seed-translation
docs.text: doubao-seed-translation is ByteDance's in-house multilingual translation model, built on a 7B multilingual text foundation model trained from scratch. It translates between 28 languages and is meant to shed the stilted 'translationese' of small models in favour of faithful, idiomatic and fluent output.

docs.subject: ent_seedance-1.0-pro-fast
docs.text: Doubao-Seedance-1.0-pro-fast is a video generation model that strikes an excellent balance between generation quality, speed and cost. It supports text-to-video and first-frame image-to-video at 480p, 720p or 1080p, 24 fps, for clips of 2-12 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_seedance-2.0-fast
docs.text: One of the three Doubao Seedance 2.0 video models; Volcengine recommends Seedance 2.0 Fast when you want to balance cost and generation speed and do not need the very highest quality. Like the rest of the series it accepts image, video, audio and text input and covers text-to-video, first- and last-frame image-to-video, omni-modal reference-to-video, video editing and video extension at 480p or 720p, 24 fps, 4-15 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_seedance-2.0-mini
docs.text: One of the three Doubao Seedance 2.0 video models; Volcengine recommends Seedance 2.0 Mini when the priority is lowest cost. It supports the same feature set as the rest of the series - text-to-video, first- and last-frame image-to-video, omni-modal reference-to-video, video editing and video extension - at 480p or 720p, 24 fps, 4-15 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_doubao-embedding-vision
docs.text: Doubao-embedding-vision is ByteDance's multimodal embedding model. It converts mixed input of text, images and video into a unified vector representation so you can process cross-modal data efficiently and run accurate text-to-image, image-to-image and combined text-image search, with dense, sparse and multi-vector output types depending on version.

docs.subject: ent_gemma-4-e2b
docs.text: Gemma 4 E2B is an open multimodal model with 2B effective parameters, built for ultra-mobile, edge, and browser deployment (for example Pixel and Chrome).

docs.subject: ent_gemma-4-26b
docs.text: Gemma 4 26B A4B is a highly efficient 26B Mixture-of-Experts open model designed for high-throughput, advanced reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_gemma-3n-e4b
docs.text: Gemma 3n is a generative AI model optimized for use in everyday devices, such as phones, laptops, and tablets; E4B runs with about 4 billion effective parameters.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-2--imagen-1
docs.text: Imagen 2 is Google's text-to-image technology on Vertex AI, generating high-quality, photorealistic, high-resolution images from natural language prompts, with text rendering, logo generation, captioning and visual question answering.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-3
docs.text: The Imagen 3 models generate and edit images using text and visual inputs; the generate variants (imagen-3.0-generate-002/001) turn text prompts into images with digital watermarking and configurable safety settings.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-3-fast
docs.text: imagen-3.0-fast-generate-001 is the Imagen 3 fast generation variant that generates images from text prompts, optimized for lower latency, with digital watermarking and user-configurable safety settings.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-4
docs.text: Imagen 4 is Google's latest line of image generation models, a high-fidelity text-to-image model capable of generating realistic and high quality images from text prompts.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-4-fast
docs.text: imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001 is the speed-optimized Imagen 4 variant, generating images from text prompts faster, at resolutions up to 1408x768, with up to 4 images per prompt.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-4-ultra
docs.text: imagen-4.0-ultra-generate-001 is the highest-quality Imagen 4 variant, generating images from text prompts at resolutions up to 2816x1536 with digital watermarking and Content Credentials support.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-4.0
docs.text: imagen-4.0-generate-001 is the standard Imagen 4 model, balancing quality and speed to generate up to 4 images per text prompt at resolutions up to 2816x1536.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-4.0-fast
docs.text: imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001 is the faster Imagen 4 endpoint for text-to-image generation, producing PNG or JPEG images with lower latency at resolutions up to 1408x768.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-4.0-ultra
docs.text: imagen-4.0-ultra-generate-001 is the quality-focused Imagen 4 endpoint for text-to-image generation, producing PNG or JPEG images at resolutions up to 2816x1536.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-product-recontext
docs.text: Imagen product recontext lets you generate images of products in different scenes or backgrounds: you provide an image of a product and a prompt, and it generates images of your product in new scenes.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-virtual-try-on
docs.text: Virtual Try-On lets you generate virtual try-on images from an image of a person and product photos that you provide.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-visual-captioning
docs.text: Imagen visual captioning (imagetext@001) uses the Imagen model to get a short, general description of a supplied image.

docs.subject: ent_imagen-visual-q-a
docs.text: Imagen Visual Q&A (imagetext@001) uses the Imagen model to ask a question and get an answer about a supplied image.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview
docs.text: Google's low-latency, audio-to-audio model optimized for real-time dialogue and voice-first AI applications, with acoustic nuance detection, numeric precision, and multimodal awareness.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview
docs.text: Provides powerful, low-latency speech generation with natural outputs, steerable prompts, and expressive audio tags for precise narration control.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview
docs.text: Google's low-latency, audio-to-audio model optimized for real-time translation of spoken conversations, supporting 70+ languages.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-omni-flash
docs.text: A preview model designed for fast, conversational video generation and editing; it turns text and images into video and lets you refine generated videos through natural language conversations.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-deep-research
docs.text: A powerful agentic researcher designed for autonomous, multi-step investigations that synthesize complex information into comprehensive, cited reports.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-embedding-001
docs.text: A specialized engine for high-dimensional vector representation, providing efficient numerical mapping of text for semantic search, text classification, and RAG.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-embedding-2
docs.text: Google's first multimodal embedding model, providing efficient numerical mapping of text, images, video, audio, and PDFs into a single unified embedding space.

docs.subject: ent_multimodal-embedding
docs.text: The multimodalembedding@001 model converts image, video, and text into vectors of floating point numbers, for uses such as image classification, image search, and recommendations.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview
docs.text: A vision-language model (VLM) that brings Gemini's agentic capabilities to robotics, understanding physical spaces and planning multi-step robotic tasks.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-robotics-er-2-preview
docs.text: A vision-language model (VLM) for robotics built on Gemini 3.5 Flash, with improved spatial reasoning, video moment finding, multi-robot orchestration, and multi-step tool use.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-robotics-er-2-streaming-preview
docs.text: A vision-language model (VLM) for robotics optimized for real-time text streaming via the Live API, for low-latency robot agents processing continuous audio and video input.

docs.subject: prov_aion
docs.text: Aion Labs sells a hosted OpenAI-compatible LLM API and agent jobs billed from prepaid token credits (with a free daily allowance and custom business invoicing), and additionally publishes open-weight roleplay fine-tunes such as Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B on Hugging Face while serving its Aion models through OpenRouter.

docs.subject: prov_anthracite
docs.text: Anthracite sells nothing: it releases "Finetunes of locally hostable Large Language Models" as free open weights on Hugging Face (including GGUF and EXL2 quantizations of the Magnum v1-v4 models at 9B to 123B), funded by donations through Open Collective and sponsored compute.

docs.subject: prov_arcee
docs.text: Arcee AI describes itself as "a U.S. model lab led by builders" that develops and publicly releases open-weight foundation models, including the Trinity family (Trinity Large Thinking, Trinity Mini and the on-device Trinity Nano), emphasizing efficiency and adaptability over sheer model size.

docs.subject: prov_canopy
docs.text: Canopy Labs is the AI lab behind Orpheus TTS, "a SOTA open-source text-to-speech system built on the Llama-3b backbone" that demonstrates the emergent capabilities of using LLMs for speech synthesis.

docs.subject: prov_canopy
docs.text: Canopy Labs gives away open weights rather than a hosted service: Apache-2.0 licensed Orpheus models on Hugging Face (a finetuned production model, a pretrained model trained on 100k+ hours of English speech, and a seven-language multilingual research release) together with training, data-processing and streaming inference code on GitHub, with Baseten as its preferred inference partner.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4.20-reasoning
docs.text: xAI's Grok 4.20 reasoning variant (grok-4.20-0309-reasoning), described on docs.x.ai as "a high-performance model with industry-leading speed and agentic tool calling capabilities" combining "the lowest hallucination rate on the market with strict prompt adherence."

docs.subject: ent_grok-4.20-non-reasoning
docs.text: Non-reasoning variant of Grok 4.20 (grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning), the same "high-performance model with industry-leading speed and agentic tool calling capabilities" but with reasoning marked "No", prioritizing speed for function calling and structured outputs.

docs.subject: ent_grok-code-fast-1
docs.text: On docs.x.ai the slug grok-code-fast-1 now resolves as an alias to grok-build-0.1, "SpaceXAI's intelligent coding model for agentic software, engineering, and workflow tasks"; the retirement notice retired grok-code-fast-1 on 2026-05-15 with grok-build-0.1 as replacement.

docs.subject: ent_grok-3
docs.text: Retired xAI text model. Its only remaining docs page is the retirement notice, which lists grok-3 among models retired 2026-05-15; requests redirect to grok-4.3 with "none" reasoning effort. No capability description is given.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4
docs.text: Retired xAI model, slug grok-4-0709. Only the docs retirement notice remains: retired 2026-05-15, with requests redirecting to grok-4.3 at "low" reasoning effort. The page gives no description of the model itself.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4-fast
docs.text: Retired xAI model pair, slugs grok-4-fast-reasoning and grok-4-fast-non-reasoning. Only the docs retirement notice remains: both retired 2026-05-15, redirecting to grok-4.3 at "low" and "none" reasoning effort respectively. No capability description.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4.1-fast-reasoning
docs.text: Retired xAI model, slug grok-4-1-fast-reasoning. Only the docs retirement notice remains: retired 2026-05-15, with requests redirecting to grok-4.3 at "low" reasoning effort. The page gives no capability description.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4.1-fast-non-reasoning
docs.text: Retired xAI model, slug grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning. Only the docs retirement notice remains: retired 2026-05-15, with requests redirecting to grok-4.3 at "none" reasoning effort. The page gives no capability description.

docs.subject: ent_claude-mythos-5
docs.text: Anthropic model that "shares Claude Fable 5's capabilities without the safety classifiers", for the most demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work; limited release through Project Glasswing, successor to Claude Mythos Preview.

docs.subject: ent_claude-haiku-3.5
docs.text: Retired Anthropic model, API ID claude-3-5-haiku-20241022. Its only current docs source is the model-deprecations page: deprecated 2025-12-19, retired 2026-02-19, replacement claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. No capability description or context window given there.

docs.subject: ent_claude-3-sonnet
docs.text: Retired Anthropic model, API ID claude-3-sonnet-20240229. Only source in current docs is the model-deprecations page: announced 2025-01-21, retired 2025-07-21, recommended replacement claude-sonnet-4-6. No capability description or context window listed.

docs.subject: ent_claude-2.0
docs.text: Retired Anthropic model, API ID claude-2.0. Only source in current docs is the model-deprecations page: announced 2025-01-21, retired 2025-07-21, recommended replacement claude-opus-4-8. No capability description or context window listed.

docs.subject: ent_claude-2.1
docs.text: Retired Anthropic model, API ID claude-2.1. Only source in current docs is the model-deprecations page: announced 2025-01-21, retired 2025-07-21, recommended replacement claude-opus-4-8. No capability description or context window listed.

docs.subject: ent_claude-instant
docs.text: Retired Anthropic model family, API IDs claude-instant-1.0, claude-instant-1.1, claude-instant-1.2. Only source in current docs is the model-deprecations page: announced 2024-09-04, retired 2024-11-06, replacement claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. No capability description given.

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-pro
docs.text: Black Forest Labs' "recommended default model for image editing and generation", a "high quality, production-grade image editing and generation model" for production at scale, offering "top performance at affordable price".

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-pro
docs.text: text prompt + up to eight reference images

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-flex
docs.text: FLUX.2 variant for "quality with control", "specialized for typography" and best for "text rendering and preserving small details", with adjustable steps and guidance.

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-flex
docs.text: text prompt + up to eight reference images

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-max
docs.text: Top FLUX.2 tier for "highest quality, final assets", offering "maximum performance" and "vast world knowledge", and including grounding search so it can use "web searches to access real-time information".

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-max
docs.text: text prompt + up to eight reference images

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-dev
docs.text: Open-weights FLUX.2 variant for "local development" and research, free for non-commercial use with "full customization"; weights on Hugging Face for fine-tuning, deployable on your own infrastructure.

docs.subject: ent_flux-2-dev
docs.text: text prompt + up to six reference images

docs.subject: ent_flux-1.1-pro
docs.text: Black Forest Labs text-to-image model, "the standard for text-to-image generation with fast, reliable and consistently stunning results", with strong prompt adherence, served through the /flux-pro-1.1 endpoint.

docs.subject: ent_flux-1.1-pro
docs.text: image (signed URL to a JPEG or PNG, valid ten minutes)

docs.subject: ent_flux-1-kontext-pro
docs.text: FLUX.1 Kontext tier optimized for production, combining "unified editing & generation" — text-to-image plus context-aware image editing — at roughly 5-6 seconds generation time, balancing speed against quality.

docs.subject: ent_flux-1-kontext-max
docs.text: Premium FLUX.1 Kontext tier for text-to-image and context-aware editing, featuring "industry-leading typography" and "maximum prompt adherence" when output excellence matters more than speed.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-4.0
docs.text: Ideogram's newest generation model for professional design work, built for "prompt fidelity, crystal-clear type, reliable editing, native transparency, style control, and design-quality outputs" across app, API, MCP, and open weights.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-4.0
docs.text: text prompt + optional reference image + aspect ratio settings

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-3.0
docs.text: Ideogram's previous-generation image model, exposed as two API values: 3.0 Latest (V_3_1) and the earlier March 26 release (V_3_0). Still available where account and plan support it; the page gives no capability description.

docs.subject: ent_sd-xl
docs.text: Stability AI's version-1 API engine stable-diffusion-xl-1024-v1-0: "Generate images using SDXL 1.0", text-to-image at 1024x1024 by default plus seven other fixed width/height combinations. Stable Image Core is called its next-generation successor.

docs.subject: ent_command-a-plus
docs.text: Cohere's command-a-plus-05-2026, "the last model in the Command A family" and "Cohere's first Mixture of Experts model" (25B active / 218B total), with vision input, agentic, reasoning, and world-class translation across 48 languages.

docs.subject: ent_palmyra-vision-7b
docs.text: Writer's palmyra-vision appears in dev.writer.com's model docs only in the deprecated-models table, with deprecation date 2026-07-13 and Palmyra X5 as replacement for vision workloads. The docs give no description and never call it "7B".

docs.subject: ent_dbrx
docs.text: Databricks DBRX appears in current Databricks docs only in retirement tables: "DBRX / DBRX Instruct" retired from Foundation Model APIs pay-per-token on 2025-04-30 and provisioned throughput on 2025-12-19. No description or context window is given.

docs.subject: ent_glm-4-32b-0414-128k
docs.text: Z.AI describes GLM-4-32B-0414-128K as "a highly cost-effective foundation language model" with "significantly enhanced capabilities in tool use, online search, and code-related intelligent tasks."

docs.subject: ent_glm-4-32b-0414-128k
docs.text: 128K tokens context length; maximum output 16K tokens

docs.subject: ent_glm-4.5-x
docs.text: A GLM-4.5 series text model billed as "High Performance, Strong Reasoning, Ultra-Fast Response", optimized for speed-critical reasoning work with generation speed exceeding 100 tokens per second.

docs.subject: ent_glm-4.5-airx
docs.text: A GLM-4.5 series text model billed as "Lightweight, Strong Performance, Ultra-Fast Response", pairing the lightweight Air architecture with X acceleration for cost- and speed-sensitive deployments.

docs.subject: ent_glm-4.6v-flashx
docs.text: The "Lightweight, High-Speed, and Affordable" variant of GLM-4.6V, a multimodal visual-understanding model with native function calling for building multimodal agents in production.

docs.subject: ent_glm-4.6v-flashx
docs.text: 128K tokens, enough for roughly 150 pages of complex documents or a one-hour video in a single pass

docs.subject: ent_glm-4.7-flashx
docs.text: The "Lightweight, High-Speed, and Affordable" member of the GLM-4.7 series, aimed at agentic coding and frontend/backend development where speed and cost matter.

docs.subject: ent_glm-asr-2512
docs.text: "GLM-ASR-2512 is Z.AI's next-generation speech recognition model, enabling real-time conversion of speech into high-quality text", reporting a Character Error Rate of 0.0717.

docs.subject: ent_glm-asr-2512
docs.text: Audio must not exceed 30 seconds and file size must stay under 25 MB; no context window stated

docs.subject: ent_glm-image
docs.text: "GLM-Image is Z.AI's new flagship image generation model", built on a hybrid "autoregressive + diffusion decoder" architecture and aimed at knowledge-intensive visuals such as posters and scientific diagrams.

docs.subject: ent_glm-image
docs.text: Image dimensions 512px-2048px with width and height multiples of 32; aspect ratios 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 16:9; no context window stated

docs.subject: ent_glm-ocr
docs.text: "A lightweight professional OCR model with parameters as small as 0.9B" for text recognition from photos and documents, table structure recognition, card/form extraction, and document parsing for RAG.

docs.subject: ent_glm-ocr
docs.text: PDF + image (JPG, PNG); single image up to 10MB, PDF up to 50MB and 100 pages

docs.subject: ent_cogview-4
docs.text: "CogView-4 is Z.AI's first open-source text-to-image model", with improved semantic understanding, image quality and bilingual Chinese/English text rendering for marketing, e-commerce, games and education.

docs.subject: ent_cogview-4
docs.text: text (bilingual Chinese and English prompts of any length)

docs.subject: ent_cogvideox-3
docs.text: A video generation model that "features new frame generation capabilities that significantly improve image stability and clarity", handling dynamic subjects and realistic or 3D-style scenes.

docs.subject: ent_cogvideox-3
docs.text: image + text + start and end frame

docs.subject: ent_viduq1-text

docs.subject: ent_viduq1-image

docs.subject: ent_viduq1-start-end

docs.subject: ent_qwen-max
docs.text: Alibaba's Model Studio states "Qwen-Max supports a parameter scale of hundreds of billions and multiple input languages such as Chinese and English"; it is a general text-generation model.

docs.subject: ent_qwen-flash
docs.text: "The Qwen3 Flash model offers a powerful fusion of thinking and non-thinking modes with dynamic in-conversation switching, excelling in complex reasoning while showing significant gains in instruction following and text comprehension."

docs.subject: ent_qwq-plus
docs.text: "The enhanced version of the Qwen QwQ reasoning model, trained on the Qwen2.5 model, has significantly improved its reasoning capabilities through reinforcement learning"; it always reasons before answering.

docs.subject: ent_qwen2.5-7b
docs.text: An instruction-tuned causal language model of 7.61B parameters in the Qwen2.5 series, with improved coding, mathematics, long-text generation, structured data understanding and JSON output across 29+ languages.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-next-80b-instruct
docs.text: Model Studio calls it "a new generation of open-source, non-thinking mode model powered by Qwen3" with enhanced Chinese text understanding and logical reasoning; 80B total parameters, 3B activated.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-next-80b-instruct
docs.text: Model Studio: 131,072 tokens (max input 129,024; max output 32,768). The Qwen Hugging Face card for the same model states "262,144 natively and extensible up to 1,010,000 tokens" via YaRN (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct)

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-next-80b-thinking

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-next-80b-thinking
docs.text: Model Studio: 131,072 tokens (max input 126,976; max output 32,768). The Qwen Hugging Face card states 262,144 tokens natively, extensible to about 1M with YaRN (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Thinking)

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-embedding-8b
docs.text: The largest model in the Qwen3 Embedding series, built for text embedding and ranking tasks across more than 100 languages, with optional task-specific instructions.

docs.subject: ent_qwen3-embedding-8b

docs.subject: ent_qwen-image-2.0-pro
docs.text: "The full-featured Qwen-Image-2.0 series models integrate image generation and image editing"; it "Excels at accurately rendering Chinese and English text that blends naturally with physical materials. Ideal for creating charts, posters, and presentations."

docs.subject: ent_nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b
docs.text: up to 1M tokens (about 256K practical on a single H100)

docs.subject: ent_nemotron-3-asr-0.6b
docs.text: NVIDIA's 600M-parameter English streaming ASR model (page name "Nemotron-ASR-Streaming", repo nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b), a cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT for low-latency English transcription with punctuation and capitalization.

docs.subject: ent_nemotron-3-asr-0.6b
docs.text: text (English transcription with punctuation and capitalization)

docs.subject: ent_nemotron-3.5-asr-0.6b
docs.text: A multilingual, streaming 600M-parameter automatic speech recognition model delivering high-quality transcription across 40 language-locales for both low-latency streaming and high-throughput batch workloads, with native punctuation and capitalization.

docs.subject: ent_parakeet-tdt-0.6b
docs.text: A 600M-parameter multilingual automatic speech recognition model for high-throughput speech-to-text transcription across 25 European languages, auto-detecting the spoken language and adding punctuation, capitalization and timestamps.

docs.subject: ent_parakeet-tdt-0.6b
docs.text: text with punctuation and capitalization, plus word-level and segment-level timestamps

docs.subject: prov_inception
docs.text: Inception (also known as Inception Labs) is an AI research and product company that builds diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) for production applications, best known for its Mercury model family.

docs.subject: prov_inception
docs.text: Inception sells access to its proprietary Mercury 2 and Mercury Edit 2 diffusion LLMs through a hosted OpenAI-compatible REST API priced per million tokens, with a free starter token allowance, native Python/TypeScript SDKs, and a Mercury chat interface.

docs.subject: prov_inclusionai
docs.text: InclusionAI is the open-source organization that serves as the home for Ant Group's Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) initiative, working on large language models, reinforcement learning and related systems.

docs.subject: prov_intfloat
docs.text: intfloat sells nothing and instead publishes free open-weight text embedding models on Hugging Face — including multilingual-e5-small/base/large, multilingual-e5-large-instruct and e5-mistral-7b-instruct — released under the MIT license.

docs.subject: prov_kuaishou
docs.text: Kuaishou is a Chinese short-video and live-streaming social platform company, listed in Hong Kong and headquartered in Beijing, which also develops generative AI models including the Kling video generation family and the KwaiCoder/KAT-Coder code models.

docs.subject: prov_kuaishou
docs.text: Kuaishou publishes open-weight models on Hugging Face through teams such as Kwaipilot (KwaiCoder, KAT-Dev, KAT-Coder and HiPO code and reasoning models) and Kwai-Kolors (the Kolors text-to-image model), while its Kling AI video and image generation models are offered as a hosted consumer and API product.

docs.subject: ent_codestral-2
docs.text: Codestral is Mistral AI's cutting-edge language model for code completion, specializing in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM) and code generation. Mistral positions it as a low-latency coding model optimized for high-frequency completion, fill-in-the-middle, and code generation tasks.

docs.subject: ent_flux-1-schnell
docs.text: FLUX.1 [schnell] is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of generating images from text descriptions. Black Forest Labs states it generates high-quality images in only 1 to 4 steps with competitive prompt following, matching the performance of closed source alternatives, and is released under Apache 2.0 for personal, scientific and commercial use.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-2.0-flash-live-api
docs.text: The Gemini 2.0 Flash Live model works with the Live API to enable low-latency bidirectional voice and video interactions with Gemini. The model can process text, audio, and video input, and it can provide text and audio output.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-09-2025
docs.text: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite Preview (model string gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-09-2025) is Google's updated September 2025 release of Flash-Lite, its most cost-efficient multimodal model, offering the fastest performance for high-frequency, lightweight tasks such as high-volume classification, simple data extraction and extremely low-latency applications. Google says the update brings better instruction following, more concise answers with about 50% fewer output tokens, more accurate audio transcription, better image understanding and improved translation quality.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-2.5-pro-computer-use-preview
docs.text: The Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model (gemini-2.5-computer-use-preview-10-2025) is an agentic capability model designed for direct interface interaction, allowing Gemini to perceive and navigate digital environments. Google says it is best for browser automation, multi-step software tasks and UI testing that requires visual reasoning and precise cursor control.

docs.subject: ent_gemini-embedding-2-multimodal
docs.text: Gemini Embedding 2 is Google's first multimodal embedding model, providing efficient numerical mapping of text, images, video, audio, and PDFs into a single unified embedding space. Google says it is best for cross-modal semantic search, document retrieval and recommendation systems that need fast, scalable similarity calculations across large multimodal datasets.

docs.subject: ent_gpt-5.5-cyber
docs.text: GPT-5.5-Cyber is OpenAI's cyber-permissive variant of GPT-5.5, trained to be more permissive on security-related tasks so that approved defenders can carry out specialized authorized workflows such as security education, defensive programming and responsible vulnerability research. OpenAI rolled it out in limited preview through its Trusted Access for Cyber program to defenders responsible for securing critical infrastructure.

docs.subject: ent_grok-3-mini
docs.text: Grok 3 Mini is a lightweight model that thinks before responding: fast, smart, and great for logic-based tasks that do not require deep domain knowledge, with the raw thinking traces accessible. xAI describes it as representing a new frontier in cost-efficient reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4.1
docs.text: Grok 4.1 is a new model featuring more natural, fluid dialogue while maintaining strong core reasoning capabilities, publicly available through xAI's web and mobile consumer apps. It ships in two configurations: Grok 4.1 Non-Thinking, which responds directly, and Grok 4.1 Thinking, which reasons before responding.

docs.subject: ent_whisper-large-v3
docs.text: Whisper large-v3 is a Transformer-based encoder-decoder model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation, proposed by OpenAI and trained on over 5 million hours of labelled data, which lets it generalise to many datasets and domains in a zero-shot setting. It transcribes audio in the source language and can translate speech into English text.

docs.subject: ent_stepaudio-2.5-chat
docs.text: StepAudio 2.5 Chat is StepFun's end-to-end speech-understanding model served through an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completion API. It interprets not only the words spoken but paralinguistic cues such as tone, hesitation and emotion, and answers in text.

docs.subject: ent_stepaudio-2.5-realtime
docs.text: StepAudio 2.5 Realtime is StepFun's end-to-end speech-to-speech model served over a WebSocket Realtime API. It takes audio or text and streams back audio plus a matching transcript, with server-side voice activity detection for natural turn-taking, removing the need for separate STT and TTS stages.

docs.subject: ent_stepaudio-2.5-tts
docs.text: StepAudio 2.5 TTS is StepFun's contextual speech-synthesis model that combines global and inline context control with zero-shot voice cloning, so emotion, pacing, pauses and delivery are described in plain natural language rather than tags. It accepts up to 1,000 characters of text per request and an optional 3-second reference clip for cloning.

docs.subject: ent_synthesia-avatar-video
docs.text: Synthesia's AI video generator turns text prompts, scripts, documents, slide decks or URLs into studio-quality presenter-led video without filming, using a library of 240+ AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages. Output is exported as MP4, shareable links or SCORM packages for enterprise LMS use.

docs.subject: ent_tavily-extract
docs.text: Tavily Extract is a web-scraping endpoint optimised for LLMs that retrieves and cleans page content from one or more supplied URLs (up to 20 per request), returning raw content as markdown or plain text with optional images and favicons.

docs.subject: ent_tavily-search
docs.text: Tavily Search is a search engine built for LLM agents: the /search endpoint takes a query and returns relevance-ranked web results with title, URL and content snippets, plus an optional LLM-generated answer, with filtering by domain, country, language and date.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-embedding
docs.text: Hunyuan Embedding is Tencent's vectorisation API that converts text into high-quality 1024-dimensional vectors for search, clustering and similarity work. A request accepts a single string or a list of up to 50 items, with a combined length of no more than 1024 tokens.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-image
docs.text: Hunyuan Image (混元生图) is Tencent's text-to-image model, which intelligently creates image content matching a text description. It automatically expands and optimises the prompt and offers 18 preset styles plus custom styles, 8 resolution options and 1-4 images per call with random or fixed seed.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-role-latest
docs.text: Hy-Role-Latest is Tencent Hunyuan's role-playing model, tuned for chat experience and plot interaction so it stays in character across personas and story scenarios. Tencent lists it with a 32k context window, 28k maximum input and 4k maximum output.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-t1-vision
docs.text: Hunyuan-t1-vision is Tencent's visual deep-thinking model, improved across image-text Q&A, visual grounding, OCR, chart reading, solving problems from photographs and image-based creation, with stronger English and multilingual ability.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-translation
docs.text: Hunyuan-translation is Tencent's dedicated machine-translation model, covering 38 or more languages including Chinese, English, Arabic and Japanese with performance optimised across the pairs.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-translation-lite
docs.text: Hunyuan-translation-lite is the lighter member of Tencent's translation family, specialised for 16 or more languages through high-quality multilingual training.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-turbos-vision
docs.text: hunyuan-turbos-vision is Tencent Hunyuan's TurboS-based multimodal model for image understanding and image-to-text tasks. Tencent has announced its shutdown on 22 June 2026 and directs users to migrate to HY-Vision-2.0-Instruct or YT-VITA.

docs.subject: ent_hunyuan-turbos-vision-video
docs.text: hunyuan-turbos-vision-video is Tencent's video-understanding model built on Hunyuan TurboS-vision, supporting video description, question answering about video content and other basic video comprehension. Tencent lists a maximum 24k input and 8k output.

docs.subject: ent_hy-role
docs.text: Hy-Role is the role-playing model in Tencent's TokenHub Hunyuan catalogue, built to fit a wide range of personas and to act out storylines. Tencent lists a 32k context window with 28k maximum input and 4k maximum output.

docs.subject: ent_hy-vision-1.5-instruct
docs.text: Hunyuan-Vision-1.5 is Tencent's vision-language model built on a mamba-transformer hybrid architecture for multilingual multimodal understanding and reasoning, covering image and video recognition, OCR, diagram understanding, visual reasoning and 3D spatial comprehension with efficient inference.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-astra
docs.text: Astra is Topaz Labs' creative video model: a diffusion-based upscaler that takes AI-generated footage to 4K while generating new detail, with an adjustable creative-intensity parameter. Because it adds detail it can change objects, identity and stylisation, and it runs only in the cloud.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-bloom
docs.text: Bloom is Topaz Labs' family of creative image models that creatively upscale AI-made images up to 8x with optional text prompts steering the added detail. It prioritises the look over strict fidelity and can alter objects, identity and stylisation.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-generative
docs.text: Topaz's generative enhancement models (the Wonder family for images) improve quality by adding recovered detail and texture while preserving the original image intent, restoring low-quality photographs in a single step and offering generative face recovery.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-gigapixel
docs.text: Gigapixel is Topaz Labs' precision image-enhancement family for upscaling photos, graphics and print while staying faithful to the source, with generative and non-generative face restoration. Eight variants cover cases such as art and CGI, transparent images, low resolution, faces and text.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-proteus
docs.text: Proteus is Topaz Labs' precision video enhancement family, designed to improve resolution, reduce noise and remove compression artefacts without introducing artificial edges or altering the character of the footage. It handles camera, CGI and AI-generated sources from standard definition to 8K and beyond.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-starlight
docs.text: Starlight is Topaz Labs' family of diffusion-based generative video enhancement models, used to restore difficult archival footage and to clean up AI-generated video, recovering detail and refining facial realism while scaling cleanly to 4K.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-upscale
docs.text: The Topaz Labs API's Enhance endpoint upscales, restores and transforms images at scale with the company's proprietary AI models; one credit covers up to 24 megapixels of output, with larger sizes costing more credits.

docs.subject: ent_topaz-video-upscale
docs.text: The Topaz Labs API's video upscale endpoint applies the company's proprietary enhancement models to footage at any project scale, upscaling and restoring video through a REST interface on the same credit-based pricing.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-animation-retarget
docs.text: Tripo Animation Retarget applies a preset animation to an already-rigged 3D model, choosing one or several presets from a library of 90+ biped motions (walk, dance, jump and so on) plus a smaller set for other body types, and returns the animated model.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-auto-rig
docs.text: Tripo Auto Rig automatically adds a skeleton rig to a 3D model supplied as a task id, file token or public URL (GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ or STL up to 150 MB), covering biped characters as well as quadruped, hexapod, octopod, avian, serpentine and aquatic creatures, and returns a rigged GLB or FBX.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-convert
docs.text: Tripo Convert Format turns a 3D model into another format — GLTF, FBX, USDZ, OBJ, STL or 3MF — with optional mesh processing, UV packing, texture baking, symmetry enforcement and animation export.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-h-series
docs.text: Tripo's H series (flagship H3.1) is the high-fidelity text- and image-to-3D generator, producing a high-fidelity mesh with PBR textures in roughly 40 seconds; it is the choice when visual accuracy and structural precision matter more than speed.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-p-series
docs.text: Tripo's P series (P1, the Smart Mesh model) generates game-ready low-poly meshes with clean, organised topology from text or images in around 10 seconds, aimed at mobile and engine-ready assets that need little manual cleanup.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-retopology
docs.text: Tripo Smart Retopology v2.0 is the mesh post-processing task that rebuilds a model's topology into clean, low-polygon geometry suitable for rigging, animation and game engines; Tripo prices the v2.0 Smart tier at 30 credits against 10 for the v1.0 basic tier.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-segmentation
docs.text: Tripo Mesh Segmentation performs semantic segmentation on a 3D model and automatically splits it into parts, taking a task id, file token or URL (GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ, STL up to 150 MB) and returning a segmented GLB plus a rendered preview. Version 2.0 adds labelling, granularity control and optional reference-image guidance.

docs.subject: ent_tripo-texture
docs.text: Tripo Texture regenerates the texture maps of an existing 3D model, guided by a text description, a single reference image, a four-view reference set or a style image plus prompt, with quality levels and optional PBR material generation. It returns a textured GLB and a rendered preview.

docs.subject: ent_unstructured-platform
docs.text: The Unstructured Platform is a no-code, pay-as-you-go service for turning unstructured data into retrieval-augmented-generation-ready data. It connects to source systems and runs documents through routing, transformation into a standard JSON schema, chunking, optional image and table enrichment, embedding and persistence to a destination such as a vector database.

docs.subject: ent_document-classify
docs.text: Upstage Document Classify sorts an input document into one of your own user-defined categories, working across scanned images, photographs and born-digital PDFs with no templates and no fine-tuning, so it can be used to route documents into the right downstream extraction schema.

docs.subject: ent_document-ocr
docs.text: Upstage Document OCR detects and recognises text in a wide range of document images with high accuracy across languages and image qualities, staying robust on rotated pages, watermarks, noise and checkboxes, and supports Hangul and Hanja as well as low-quality scans.

docs.subject: ent_document-parse
docs.text: Upstage Document Parse automatically converts any document into structured text such as HTML or Markdown. It detects layout elements including paragraphs, tables and images, serialises them in reading order and outputs structured text for RAG pipelines, document QA and automation.

docs.subject: ent_information-extract
docs.text: Upstage Information Extract performs schema-free key information extraction from any document type — complex PDFs, scans and Office files — without templates or fine-tuning, dynamically producing structured output for a supplied schema and inferring implied values such as totals derived from line items.

docs.subject: ent_solar-embedding-1-large
docs.text: Solar Embedding 1 Large is Upstage's Solar-based embedding model, released as paired query and passage variants with a 4k context limit: the query model is optimised for embedding a user's question and the passage model for embedding documents to be searched. It is deprecated in favour of Solar Embedding 2.

docs.subject: ent_solar-embedding-2
docs.text: Solar Embedding 2 is Upstage's current embedding pair (solar-embedding-2-query and solar-embedding-2-passage), fine-tuned from microsoft/harrier-oss-v1-0.6b, with an 8k context limit and 1,024-dimensional vectors for semantic search, clustering and multilingual retrieval.

docs.subject: ent_solar-mini
docs.text: Solar Mini is Upstage's compact 10.7-billion-parameter instruction-following conversational model for businesses, supporting English, Korean and Japanese with chat, structured outputs and function calling, and designed to fine-tune well.

docs.subject: ent_solar-pro-2
docs.text: Solar Pro 2 is Upstage's 31-billion-parameter flagship model, recognised as a 2025 frontier model, that supports both a fast chat mode and a structured multi-step reasoning mode in a single model, along with structured outputs and function calling in English, Korean and Japanese.

docs.subject: ent_veryfi-bank-checks
docs.text: Veryfi's Bank Checks OCR API reads the front and back of a cheque image and returns structured JSON: MICR routing, account and serial numbers, cheque number, amount, date, payer and payee, bank details, signature and endorsement detection, plus X9.37 and ACH compliance formats and fraud signals.

docs.subject: ent_veryfi-bank-statements
docs.text: Veryfi's Bank Statements OCR API uses machine learning to read printed or handwritten bank statements in any language or currency and convert them into structured JSON — account holder and bank details, opening and closing balances and itemised transactions with categories — for reconciliation, loan verification and fraud detection.

docs.subject: ent_veryfi-invoices
docs.text: Veryfi's invoice and receipt OCR API converts invoices and bills submitted as images, PDFs or file URLs into machine-readable JSON, extracting vendor details, dates, line items with quantities and prices, taxes, totals and currency for accounts-payable and expense automation.

docs.subject: ent_veryfi-receipts
docs.text: Veryfi's Receipts & Invoices OCR API turns receipt documents (JPG, PNG, PDF and more) into structured JSON using foundation models trained on hundreds of millions of receipts, returning over 150 fields — merchant details, dates, line items, taxes, totals, barcodes, fraud indicators and OCR confidence — across 91 currencies and 38 languages.

docs.subject: ent_veryfi-w2-w9
docs.text: Veryfi's W-2 and W-9 OCR API extracts data from US tax forms automatically, reading handwriting and checkboxes and returning structured JSON with employee and employer identity fields, wage and withholding boxes and state and local tax information for tax-preparation, HR and loan workflows.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-2.0
docs.text: Vidu 2.0 is the earlier generation of Vidu's video model, valued for fast generation. It runs at 360p, 720p or 1080p and 32 fps with 4-second or 8-second clips, and supports image-to-video, reference-to-video, first/last-frame control and effects templates.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-audio-1.0
docs.text: Vidu Audio 1.0 is Vidu's text-to-audio model: given a text prompt of up to 1,500 characters it generates an audio clip of 2 to 10 seconds, covering sound effects and background music, through the text2audio endpoint.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-lip-sync
docs.text: Vidu Lip Sync generates lip-synchronised video driven either by text or by an audio track, matching a character's mouth movements to the supplied speech.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q1
docs.text: Vidu Q1 is Vidu's earlier flagship video model, noted for sharp visuals, generating 5-second 1080p clips at 24 fps from text, an image, reference images or first and last frames.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q2-image
docs.text: Vidu Q2 Image is the image-generation mode of the viduq2 model: it takes a text prompt of up to 2,000 characters and 0-7 reference images and produces images at 1080p, 2K or 4K in a wide range of aspect ratios, keeping subjects consistent with the references, and also supports image editing.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q2-pro
docs.text: Vidu Q2-pro is the high-end model of the Q2 video series, distinguished by strong visual aesthetics and support for video editing within reference-based generation. It covers 540p to 1080p at 24 fps for 1-10 second clips with image-to-video, reference-to-video and first/last-frame control.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q2-turbo
docs.text: Vidu Q2-turbo is the fast tier of the Q2 video series, generating 1-10 second clips at 540p to 1080p and 24 fps from an image or from first and last frames, trading some quality for speed.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q3-mix
docs.text: Vidu Q3-mix is the reference-to-video model of Vidu's Q3 series, tuned for a better overall balance in general scenarios with improved consistency and aesthetics. It outputs audio and video together with smart scene cuts, up to 1080p at 24 fps for 1-16 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q3-pro
docs.text: Vidu Q3-pro is the top model of Vidu's Q3 video series, producing more vivid, expressive and three-dimensional content with simultaneous audio and video output and smart scene cuts. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video and first/last-frame control at 540p to 1080p, 24 fps, 1-16 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-q3-turbo
docs.text: Vidu Q3-turbo is the fast tier of the Q3 video series, keeping simultaneous audio and video output and smart scene cuts while generating quickly. It handles text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video and first/last frames at 540p to 1080p, 24 fps, 1-16 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-s1
docs.text: Vidu S1 is Vidu's low-latency streaming model for live interaction and real-time companionship, described by Vidu as the first commercial-grade interactive digital character capable of interaction, performance and bidirectional perception.

docs.subject: ent_vidu-upscale-pro
docs.text: Vidu Upscale-Pro raises the resolution of a generated video to 1080p, 2K or 4K (and up to 8K on Vidu's price list) as a post-processing step.

docs.subject: ent_voyage-context-4
docs.text: voyage-context-4 is Voyage AI's contextualized chunk embedding model, optimised for general-purpose and multilingual retrieval quality: it embeds each chunk with awareness of the wider document rather than in isolation. Embeddings are returned at 1024 dimensions by default, with 256, 512 or 2048 also available and float, int8, uint8 or binary output.

docs.subject: ent_voyage-multilingual-2
docs.text: voyage-multilingual-2 is Voyage AI's embedding model optimised for multilingual retrieval and RAG, producing 1024-dimensional vectors from text.

docs.subject: ent_voyage-multimodal-3
docs.text: voyage-multimodal-3 is Voyage AI's previous-generation multimodal embedding model, which vectorises interleaved text and content-rich images such as screenshots of PDFs, slides, tables and figures into a shared 1024-dimensional space.

docs.subject: ent_palmyra-x4
docs.text: Palmyra X4 is Writer's language model for complex tasks that require extended context, strong at code generation, retrieval-augmented generation and tool calling for API interactions. Writer has scheduled it for deprecation on 18 November 2026.

docs.subject: ent_palmyra-x6
docs.text: Palmyra X6 is Writer's agentic model and the default for WRITER Agent, built for long-horizon enterprise workflows with sub-agents, grounding and MCP tool use; Writer says it can hold a single objective for up to eight hours without supervision, planning, executing and verifying its own work.

docs.subject: ent_writer-data-extraction
docs.text: Data extraction is one of the per-page capabilities Writer bills for Knowledge Graph, its graph-based retrieval-augmented generation service: it pulls the structured content out of files added to a Knowledge Graph so they can be indexed and queried. Writer prices it at $0.00015 per page.

docs.subject: ent_writer-file-parsing
docs.text: File parsing (OCR) is the Knowledge Graph capability that reads scanned and image-based files added to a Writer Knowledge Graph so their text can be indexed for retrieval. Writer prices it at $0.055 per page.

docs.subject: ent_writer-pdf-parser
docs.text: Writer's PDF parser endpoint converts PDF documents into other formats, extracting text content for further analysis — for example turning research papers into searchable text or PDF documentation into markdown. Writer has deprecated the endpoint in favour of a prebuilt parsing tool for chat completions.

docs.subject: ent_writer-web-access
docs.text: Web Access is the Writer Knowledge Graph capability that fetches web content: adding web connector URLs to a Knowledge Graph automatically extracts and indexes single pages or whole sub-page trees so the content can be queried alongside uploaded files. Writer prices it at $0.12 per page.

docs.subject: ent_mimo-v2.5-asr
docs.text: MiMo-V2.5-ASR is Xiaomi's open-source end-to-end automatic speech recognition model, trained with large-scale mid-training, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. It transcribes Mandarin and English plus Chinese dialects, code-switched speech, song lyrics, knowledge-dense content, noisy audio and multi-speaker conversations, emitting punctuated text with no post-processing.

docs.subject: ent_mimo-v2.5-pro-ultraspeed
docs.text: MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed is the high-speed serving mode of Xiaomi's trillion-parameter MiMo-V2.5-Pro, reaching output speeds of up to about 1,000 tokens per second for latency-critical work such as real-time reasoning, coding agents and high-speed agent loops. It supports streaming, tool calling, context caching and deep thinking.

docs.subject: ent_glm-4.6v-flash
docs.text: GLM-4.6V-Flash is Z.ai's lightweight (roughly 9-10B parameter) open-weight vision-language model, the small companion to the 106B GLM-4.6V, aimed at local deployment and low-latency use. It takes images, screenshots and documents alongside text and returns text, with native function calling that accepts images as tool parameters.

docs.subject: ent_glm-5.1-tee
docs.text: GLM-5.1 is Z.ai's flagship foundation model for extended autonomous work: Z.ai says it can work continuously on a single task for up to eight hours, running the full loop from planning and execution through iterative optimisation to production-grade delivery, and it is aimed at long-horizon coding agents. Maximum output is 128K tokens.

docs.subject: ent_glm-5.2-tee
docs.text: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's flagship foundation model built for long-horizon tasks, with what Z.ai calls a truly usable 1M-token context so entire codebases and project architectures fit in a single interaction. It is text-in, text-out with a maximum output of 128K tokens.

docs.subject: ent_zapier-mcp
docs.text: Zapier MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants and agents take real actions across the 9,000+ apps Zapier integrates with — sending email, updating spreadsheets, scheduling meetings, posting messages — on demand from a natural-language request rather than on a Zap trigger, reusing the app connections the account already has.

docs.subject: ent_zembed-1
docs.text: zembed-1 is ZeroEntropy's flagship open-weight multilingual text embedding model, distilled from its zerank-2 reranker. It accepts a string or list of strings with an input_type of query or document to exploit asymmetric retrieval, and returns vectors at a selectable 2560 (default), 1280, 640, 320, 160, 80 or 40 dimensions.

docs.subject: ent_zerank-2
docs.text: zerank-2 is ZeroEntropy's flagship state-of-the-art reranker, a cross-encoder that takes a query plus candidate documents and returns deterministic relevance scores, ordering results with its zELO methodology in which candidates compete in pairwise battles for a continuous Elo-style relevance score.

docs.subject: ent_gemma-sea-lion-v4-27b-it
docs.text: Gemma-SEA-LION-v4-27B-IT is AI Singapore's instruction-tuned adaptation of Google's Gemma 3 for Southeast Asian languages, post-trained on roughly 10 million QA samples across Burmese, English, Indonesian, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Tagalog, Tamil, Thai and Vietnamese. It understands both images and text, including document comprehension and visual Q&A, and supports function calling and structured outputs.

docs.subject: ent_qwen-sea-lion-v4-32b-it
docs.text: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-32B-IT is AI Singapore's instruction-tuned model built on Qwen3-32B, continued-pretrained on about 100 billion tokens of SEA-Pile v2 covering Burmese, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Tamil, Thai and Vietnamese and post-trained on some 8 million QA pairs for instruction following and multi-turn chat, with an optional thinking mode.

docs.subject: ent_gemma-4-31b-it-pearl
docs.text: Gemma-4-31B-it-pearl is Pearl Research Labs' distribution of Google's instruction-tuned Gemma 4 (31B parameters, Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration) adapted for the Pearl Proof-of-Useful-Work mining protocol, so an inference server running it with Pearl's vLLM plugin can serve requests and participate in the mining network. It takes image and text input and returns text.

docs.subject: ent_bielik-11b-v3.0-instruct
docs.text: Bielik-11B-v3.0-Instruct is an 11-billion-parameter multilingual generative model from SpeakLeash and ACK Cyfronet AGH, instruction-tuned from Bielik-11B-v3 on over 20 million instructions and aligned with DPO-Positive and GRPO reinforcement learning. It is optimised above all for Polish while supporting 32 European languages, and takes ChatML-formatted prompts.

docs.subject: ent_apertus-70b-instruct-2509
docs.text: Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 is the 70-billion-parameter instruction-tuned model of the Swiss AI Initiative's fully open Apertus family — open weights, open data and documented methodology — trained on 15 trillion tokens of compliant data with a staged web, code and maths curriculum. It supports over 1000 languages and tool use.

docs.subject: ent_apertus-8b-instruct-2509
docs.text: Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 is the 8-billion-parameter member of the Swiss AI Initiative's fully open Apertus family, a lighter alternative to the 70B model with the same architecture, multilingual coverage of over 1000 languages and training on 15 trillion tokens of consent-respecting data.

docs.subject: ent_apertus-v1.5-70b
docs.text: Apertus v1.5 70B is the large model of the Swiss AI Initiative's open-source Apertus 1.5 family, pretrained on 17 trillion tokens and multimodal: it accepts images, audio and text and generates text, with an optional thinking mode that improves reasoning performance.

docs.subject: ent_apertus-v1.5-8b
docs.text: Apertus v1.5 8B is the small model of the Swiss AI Initiative's open-source Apertus 1.5 family, pretrained on 19 trillion tokens; like the 70B it accepts images, audio and text, generates text and offers an optional thinking mode for reasoning tasks.

docs.subject: ent_mistral-nemo-instruct-2407-tee
docs.text: Mistral NeMo Instruct 2407 is a 12-billion-parameter instruction-tuned model built jointly by Mistral AI and NVIDIA and released under Apache 2.0; it is fine-tuned and aligned for instruction following, reasoning, multi-turn conversation and code, is strong across eleven languages and uses the Tekken tokenizer. This entry is Unsloth's redistribution of those weights.

docs.subject: ent_grok-4.1-fast
docs.text: Grok 4.1 Fast is xAI's tool-calling model, described by xAI as its best tool-calling model with a 2M context window, which reasons and completes agentic tasks accurately and rapidly. It was trained with long-horizon reinforcement learning for real-world enterprise agents and can call web search, X post search, code execution and document retrieval.

docs.subject: ent_grok-imagine-image
docs.text: grok-imagine-image is the base image model of xAI's Grok Imagine family, generating images from a text prompt and optional reference images through the Imagine API, priced at $0.02 per image.

docs.subject: ent_grok-imagine-image-2.0
docs.text: grok-imagine-image-2.0 is the newer image-generation model in xAI's Grok Imagine family, covering styles from ultra-realistic photography to anime, oil painting and pencil sketch, with control over batch count, aspect ratio, resolution and quality. xAI prices it at $0.04 per image.

docs.subject: ent_grok-imagine-image-quality
docs.text: grok-imagine-image-quality is the higher-quality tier of xAI's Grok Imagine image generation, listed by xAI at $0.05 per image.

docs.subject: ent_grok-imagine-video
docs.text: grok-imagine-video is xAI's original Grok Imagine video model, which works text-to-image then image-to-video under the hood: it generates a first frame from the prompt and animates it, producing clips up to 15 seconds at 480p or 720p in a range of aspect ratios, with an audio track by default.

docs.subject: ent_grok-imagine-video-1.5
docs.text: grok-imagine-video-1.5 is the newer Grok Imagine video model, adding native 1080p for text-to-video and image-to-video, reference-to-video capped at 720p, and voice integration through preset voice ids (up to three per request), returning MP4 clips with generated audio.

docs.subject: ent_grok-voice-think-fast-1.0
docs.text: grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 is xAI's first Grok speech-to-speech voice model, taking audio and text in and returning audio and text. It is now deprecated in favour of version 2.0.

docs.subject: ent_grok-voice-think-fast-2.0
docs.text: grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 is xAI's current Grok speech-to-speech voice model, taking audio and text input and returning audio and text, billed at $0.08 per minute of audio plus text input tokens.

docs.subject: ent_nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-tee

docs.text: An agentic capability model designed for direct interface interaction, allowing Gemini to perceive and navigate digital environments; best for browser automation, multi-step software tasks, and UI testing.

docs.subject: prov_thedrummer
docs.text: He does not run a hosted API of his own; he releases free downloadable model weights (including GGUF quantisations) of fine-tunes built on other people's base models such as Mistral Small, Llama 3.3 Nemotron and Mistral NeMo, which third-party inference platforms like OpenRouter then serve.

docs.subject: prov_undi95
docs.text: Undi95 offers no hosted service or paid product; the output is free open-weight models on Hugging Face — merges and fine-tunes of existing bases such as Llama 2, Mistral and QwQ, some under non-commercial CC-BY-NC-4.0 licences — which platforms such as OpenRouter host for API access.

docs.subject: prov_xiaomi
docs.text: Xiaomi Corporation is a Chinese consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (1810.HK), whose MiMo team builds and ships the company's own AI models through the Xiaomi MiMo API Open Platform.

docs.subject: prov_xiaomi
docs.text: Xiaomi sells paid access to its MiMo models — a pay-as-you-go and subscription "Token Plan" API compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic formats, covering the MiMo-V2.5 text, omni-modal, TTS and coding models — while also publishing open weights for many MiMo models on Hugging Face.

docs.subject: prov_meituan
docs.text: Meituan publishes LongCat open foundation model weights on Hugging Face and also sells hosted API access to LongCat models through the LongCat API Platform with pay-as-you-go per-token pricing.

docs.subject: prov_morph
docs.text: Morph is a company that builds specialized, fast inference models for AI coding agents, describing itself as "the model API layer for coding agents".

docs.subject: prov_morph
docs.text: Morph sells a hosted, OpenAI-compatible API covering its Fast Apply code-edit merge models, WarpGrep code search, Compact context compaction, embeddings and rerank, priced per million tokens with a free tier of 200 requests per month.

docs.subject: prov_nexagi
docs.text: Nex AGI is an open-source AI research organization — described on its Hugging Face page as "an innovation alliance initiated by the Shanghai Innovation Institute" — that develops the Nex-N1 and Nex-N2 families of agentic mixture-of-experts models.

docs.subject: prov_nexagi
docs.text: Nex AGI releases its models as open weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope and distributes them for paid API use through third-party platforms including OpenRouter and SiliconFlow rather than running its own commercial API.

docs.subject: prov_perceptron
docs.text: Perceptron offers a hosted API for its vision-language models (the closed-source flagship Mk1 and the open-source Isaac 0.1 and Isaac 0.2), plus commercial licensing of the model weights for enterprises.

docs.subject: prov_poolside
docs.text: Poolside offers its Laguna agentic coding models (Laguna S 2.1 and Laguna XS 2.1) as open weights on Hugging Face plus a cloud API and terminal, editor and desktop clients, with API access free to use for a limited time.

docs.subject: prov_cognitive
docs.text: Cognitive Computations, now operating under the name Dolphin AI, is a community model-tuning group rather than a company — curated and trained by Eric Hartford together with collaborators including Ben Gitter and BlouseJury — that produces the Dolphin series of instruct-tuned open-weight language models.

docs.subject: prov_cognitive
