docs.text: They release free open-weight Dolphin fine-tunes of other companies' base models (Llama 3.1, Mistral 24B, Qwen and others) on Hugging Face under the "dphn" organization, alongside a hosted web chat and a Telegram bot, rather than selling their own inference API.

docs.subject: prov_gryphe
docs.text: Gryphe publishes free open weights on Hugging Face — merges and fine-tunes built on other organizations' base models such as Llama 2, Gemma and Qwen — and does not run a hosted API, with third parties like OpenRouter selling inference on models including MythoMax 13B and MythoMist 7B.

docs.subject: prov_hexgrad
docs.text: Hexgrad is an individual developer on Hugging Face rather than a company, and is the author of Kokoro, an open-weight text-to-speech model with 82 million parameters that delivers quality comparable to larger models while being faster and more cost-efficient.

docs.subject: prov_hexgrad
docs.text: Hexgrad sells nothing directly and instead releases Apache-2.0 open weights on Hugging Face — Kokoro-82M plus the Misaki G2P library and a demo Space — with hosted Kokoro inference sold by third parties such as Replicate and DeepInfra.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-lipsync
docs.text: HeyGen's Lipsync API dubs or replaces the audio on an existing video and re-syncs the speaker's mouth movements to the new track, running asynchronously via POST /v3/lipsyncs. It offers a Precision mode for frame-accurate mouth movements on long-form, cinematic video and a Speed mode for faster dubbing and localization.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-starfish
docs.text: Starfish is HeyGen's own text-to-speech engine, used to generate speech audio from a text script; compatible voices are listed with GET /v3/voices?engine=starfish. It is tuned for natural pronunciation and pacing, including Asian languages such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-video-agent
docs.text: The HeyGen Video Agent API turns a text prompt into a finished video end to end, autonomously orchestrating avatar creation, script writing and visual asset and layout generation. It accepts up to 20 file attachments so a video can be grounded in an internal wiki, product doc or knowledge base article.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-video-translation
docs.text: HeyGen's Video Translation API translates and dubs an existing video into one or more target languages with voice cloning and lip-sync, covering 175+ languages and dialects. It is exposed at POST /v3/video-translations.

docs.subject: ent_evi-3
docs.text: EVI 3 is Hume AI's speech-to-speech foundation model, which the company calls the world's most realistic and instructible speech-language model. It listens to a user's speech and replies with expressive, emotionally aware speech, and lets developers create custom voices by prompting rather than picking from preset speakers.

docs.subject: ent_octave-2
docs.text: Octave 2 is Hume AI's next-generation multilingual text-to-speech model, fluent in 11+ languages and roughly 40% faster and 50% cheaper than Octave 1. It adds multi-speaker conversation, more reliable pronunciation, voice conversion and direct phoneme editing, and can clone a voice from as little as 15 seconds of audio.

docs.subject: ent_rodin-gen-2.5
docs.text: Rodin Gen-2.5 is Hyper3D's AI 3D model generator, which the company describes as the world's highest-quality and most controllable, turning a text prompt or one or more reference images into 3D assets with clean topology and PBR materials. It offers spatial controls (bounding box, voxel and point-cloud ControlNets), quality tiers and partial editing, and exports GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ, STL and USDZ.

docs.subject: ent_hyperagent
docs.text: HyperAgent is Hyperbrowser's open-source, Playwright-powered browser automation agent that carries out web tasks described in natural language, clicking, typing and navigating on its own. It runs on Hyperbrowser Cloud either synchronously or as a polled job, and returns the final answer plus step-by-step execution details and a live monitoring URL.

docs.subject: ent_hyperbrowser-session
docs.text: A Hyperbrowser session is an isolated cloud browser instance that you control programmatically over a WebSocket endpoint compatible with Playwright and Puppeteer. Sessions are used for scraping, testing and agentic web interaction, with configurable stealth, proxy routing, cookies, screen size and timeouts, plus a live view URL.

docs.subject: ent_granite-4.0-h-small
docs.text: Granite 4.0 H Small is IBM's 32B-parameter hybrid Mamba/transformer mixture-of-experts instruct model, designed to respond to general instructions and to build AI assistants for multiple domains including business applications. It covers summarization, classification, question answering, code completion, function calling, RAG and multilingual dialogue across 12 languages.

docs.subject: ent_granite-8b-code-instruct
docs.text: Granite 8B Code Instruct is IBM's 8B-parameter long-context instruction-tuned code model, fine-tuned on permissively licensed and synthetically generated long-context data. It responds to coding instructions over inputs up to 128K tokens and is intended for building coding assistants that generate, explain and fix code in many languages.

docs.subject: ent_granite-embedding-278m-multilingual
docs.text: Granite Embedding 278M Multilingual is a 278M-parameter encoder-only model from IBM's Granite Embeddings suite that turns text into high-quality dense vectors of size 768 for retrieval, semantic search, clustering, reranking and similarity. It covers 12 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Arabic, Czech, Italian, Korean, Dutch and Chinese.

docs.subject: ent_granite-guardian-3-8b
docs.text: The granite-guardian-3-8b foundation model is a fine-tuned Granite 3 8B Instruct model that detects risks in prompts and model responses along the dimensions catalogued in the IBM AI Risk Atlas. IBM positions it as a guardrail for enterprise applications, also scoring context relevance and groundedness for RAG and detecting risks such as function-calling hallucinations in agentic workflows.

docs.subject: ent_slate-125m-english-rtrvr-v2
docs.text: IBM's slate-125m-english-rtrvr-v2 is an encoder-only English retrieval model in watsonx.ai that generates 768-dimension embeddings for queries, passages and documents. It is a bi-encoder sentence-transformer trained to maximize cosine similarity between a query and its matching passage, used for semantic search, document comparison and reranking.

docs.subject: ent_slate-30m-english-rtrvr-v2
docs.text: IBM's slate-30m-english-rtrvr-v2 is the small, faster member of the Slate v2 English retrieval family in watsonx.ai and is the platform's default embedding model, producing 768-dimension vectors for queries and passages. It is two to three times faster than the 125m variant at slightly lower retrieval quality, and is used for semantic search, document comparison and reranking.

docs.subject: ent_watsonx-text-extraction
docs.text: The watsonx.ai text extraction service extracts text from PDFs and other highly structured documents and converts it into a format that is easier to work with programmatically, such as Markdown or JSON. It uses OCR for scanned documents and images, preserves tables, section titles, lists and footnotes, strips headers and footers, and can extract key-value pairs from documents such as invoices and utility bills.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-1.0
docs.text: Ideogram 1.0 is the first major generation of Ideogram's text-to-image model, released in February 2024 and now listed by Ideogram as a legacy model that remains selectable by its legacy API model value. It has been superseded by the 2.x, 3.0 and 4.0 generations.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-2.0
docs.text: Ideogram 2.0 is Ideogram's August 2024 text-to-image model, described by the company as a frontier model with industry-leading capabilities in generating realistic images, graphic design and typography. Its launch also brought the Ideogram iOS app, the beta API and Ideogram Search; Ideogram now lists it as the older 2.x model.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-2a
docs.text: Ideogram 2a is the faster model in Ideogram's 2.x text-to-image generation, exposed in the API as model value V_2_1. Ideogram states that 2a renders faster than 2.0 at equivalent rendering settings.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-v3
docs.text: Ideogram 3.0 is the March 2025 text-to-image model that Ideogram calls the release that turned image generation into something creative teams could use for campaigns, brand systems and polished design work. It combines photorealism, legible text rendering and Style References — uploading images or reusing style codes to steer aesthetics — and is strong on text-heavy designs such as posters, logos and brand assets.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-background-remover
docs.text: Ideogram's Background Remover strips the background from an image and returns a transparent PNG with a clean alpha channel, preserving fine details such as edges, text, hair and glass; the background can also be replaced with a generated scene from a prompt. The API endpoint POST /v1/remove-background accepts JPEG, PNG and WebP files up to 10 MB and is built for high-volume catalogue and product-listing work.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-describe
docs.text: Ideogram's Describe generates a text description from an uploaded or generated image, turning a picture back into a prompt-like caption.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-instructional-edit
docs.text: Ideogram's instructional edit endpoint edits one or more existing images from a natural-language prompt describing the change, without a mask: the scene is preserved and only the prompted change is applied. It accepts up to 10 JPEG, PNG or WebP images by upload or Ideogram URL and returns the edited images.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-layerize
docs.text: Ideogram's Layerize analyzes a flat design and returns the text baked into it as editable layers, each with its string, role, font, colour and position, alongside a text-erased base image. It lets teams localize, rewrite and restyle a design's copy without regenerating the artwork.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-object-remover
docs.text: Ideogram's Object Remover erases an unwanted object from a photo: you brush over the object to make a mask, and the model regenerates the background so shadows, grain and perspective stay consistent with the surrounding scene. It is exposed via POST /v1/remove-object and is used to remove photobombers, watermarks, text, logos and clutter.

docs.subject: ent_ideogram-upscale
docs.text: Ideogram's Upscale raises an image to 2X resolution while enhancing colour, detail, text rendering and photorealism and reducing artifacts. It works on Ideogram generations or uploaded images and is steered with resemblance and detail sliders plus an optional prompt.

docs.subject: ent_mercury-edit-2
docs.text: Mercury Edit 2 is Inception's second-generation diffusion large language model (dLLM) purpose-built for next-edit prediction, the most latency-sensitive step in modern coding workflows. Given code context, a cursor position and optionally a natural-language intent, it uses your recent edits and codebase context to predict the change you will make next, generating tokens in parallel so predictions arrive at typing speed.

docs.subject: ent_jina-deepsearch-v1
docs.text: jina-deepsearch-v1 is Jina AI's deep-research agent, which answers complex questions by iteratively searching the web, reading pages and reasoning, deciding its next step from what it has found and self-evaluating the answer before returning it. It is served at a chat-completions endpoint compatible with the OpenAI Chat API and streams reasoning steps, the final answer and citations with visited and read URLs.

docs.subject: ent_jina-embeddings-v4
docs.text: jina-embeddings-v4 is Jina AI's 3.8B-parameter universal embedding model for multimodal and multilingual retrieval, embedding text, images, audio, video and PDFs into a shared vector space.

docs.subject: ent_jina-embeddings-v5-omni-nano
docs.text: jina-embeddings-v5-omni-nano is Jina AI's compact 1.0B-parameter multimodal embedding model for edge deployment, producing embeddings across text, image, audio, video and PDF inputs.

docs.subject: ent_jina-embeddings-v5-omni-small
docs.text: jina-embeddings-v5-omni-small is Jina AI's 1.7B-parameter multimodal embedding model for text, image, audio, video and PDF, the full-size omni member of the v5 embedding family.

docs.subject: ent_jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano
docs.text: jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano is Jina AI's 239M-parameter text-only embedding model, state-of-the-art multilingual embeddings optimized for edge deployment.

docs.subject: ent_jina-embeddings-v5-text-small
docs.text: jina-embeddings-v5-text-small is Jina AI's 677M-parameter text embedding model offering state-of-the-art multilingual embeddings with task-specific adapters.

docs.subject: ent_jina-reader
docs.text: The Jina Reader API (r.jina.ai) converts a URL into LLM-friendly text: it fetches the page server-side, strips navigation, ads and other boilerplate, and returns clean markdown with title and metadata. It handles PDFs and webpages natively, captions images with a vision-language model, and offers several rendering engines plus cookie-based access to login-protected content.

docs.subject: ent_jina-reranker-v3
docs.text: jina-reranker-v3 is Jina AI's 597M-parameter listwise reranker for state-of-the-art multilingual document retrieval, reordering candidate documents against a query.

docs.subject: ent_jina-reranker-v3.5
docs.text: jina-reranker-v3.5 is Jina AI's 0.6B-parameter domain-ready listwise reranker for multilingual and structured retrieval, ranking candidate documents against a query.

docs.subject: ent_jina-search
docs.text: The Jina Search API (s.jina.ai) searches the web for a query and returns the top results with their page content already converted into LLM-friendly text. Jina positions it as a way to keep an LLM up to date, improve factuality and reduce hallucinations.

docs.subject: ent_krea-2-large
docs.text: Krea 2 Large is the high-fidelity variant of Krea 2, Krea's first foundation image model built from scratch for full creative control over style, composition, aesthetics and reference-driven results. Krea recommends Large for photorealism, raw textures and motion blur — the richest output — at slower speed than Medium.

docs.subject: ent_krea-2-medium
docs.text: Krea 2 Medium is the general-purpose variant of Krea 2, Krea's first from-scratch foundation image model, giving stable everyday output at standard generation speed. Krea recommends it for illustration, anime, painting and expressive artistic styles, with the same style references, moodboards and Generative Sliders as Large.

docs.subject: ent_kling-2.1
docs.text: Kling 2.1 is a generation of Kuaishou's Kling video model released in May 2025 as a lineup of Standard, Pro and Master tiers, emphasizing higher fidelity at 1080p/30fps for text-to-video and image-to-video generation.

docs.subject: ent_kling-2.1-master
docs.text: Kling 2.1 Master is the top tier of Kuaishou's KLING 2.1 lineup, which ships in Standard, Pro and Master versions; Master is the highest-quality option for text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 1080p.

docs.subject: ent_kling-2.5-turbo
docs.text: Kling 2.5 Turbo (API model kling-v2-5-turbo) is a video generation model in Kuaishou's Kling API line-up, which Kling summarizes as maximum creativity at exceptional value; the 2.5 generation added longer, more cinematic shots with realistic physics at reduced cost and turnaround.

docs.subject: ent_kling-2.6
docs.text: Kling VIDEO 2.6 is Kling's first native-audio video model: instead of generating silent visuals and adding sound later, it produces visuals, natural voice, action sound effects and ambient atmosphere together in a single pass. It supports speech, dialogue, narration, singing, rap and mixed sound effects, and also adds Motion Control for transferring motion from a video to an image.

docs.subject: ent_kling-3.0
docs.text: Kling VIDEO 3.0 builds on Kling VIDEO O1 and VIDEO 2.6 with a deeply integrated unified training framework that merges Native Audio with Element Consistency control and breaks through duration limits, generating up to 15 seconds of native audio-visual output. It adds Multi-Shot storyboard control, precise text rendering, stronger subject consistency and more accurate semantic response, and supports native 4K output.

docs.subject: ent_kling-3.0-omni
docs.text: Kling VIDEO 3.0 Omni is the unified multimodal member of the Kling 3.0 series, the upgrade of VIDEO O1: images, videos, elements and text you upload are all treated as prompts, and the model understands any combination of them to generate the video. Omni also adds Voice as an element, binding a specific voice to a character so they look and sound the same across scenes and shots.

docs.subject: ent_kling-3.0-turbo
docs.text: Kling 3.0 Turbo is the speed-oriented member of the Kling 3.0 series, described by Kling as faster and more reliable at scale and built for high-volume pipelines, with reduced end-to-end latency, precise audio-visual sync and consistently strong output quality.

docs.subject: ent_kling-o1
docs.text: Kling VIDEO O1 integrates diverse video tasks into a single unified architecture — reference-based generation, text-to-video, start/end-frame interpolation, video inpainting, transformation, stylization and extension — so editing and generation happen in one model. Instead of manual masking or keyframing, users prompt changes such as removing bystanders, changing daytime to dusk or replacing an outfit, and can combine several tasks in one prompt, generating 3-10 second clips.

docs.subject: ent_kling-v3-pro
docs.text: Kling Video v3 [pro] is the professional-quality tier of Kuaishou's Kling VIDEO 3.0 model, which generates up to 15-second clips with native audio, multi-shot storyboard control, precise text rendering and strong element consistency, with native 4K output available.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-2.1
docs.text: Kling IMAGE 2.1 is a generation of Kuaishou's Kling text-to-image model, which Kling characterizes by superb prompt adherence and reliable output.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-3.0
docs.text: Kling IMAGE 3.0 supports natural-language image creation together with reference images, style transfer, portrait and character reference, multi-image blending and local re-editing in one flexible image workflow. It can extract features from up to 10 reference images, locking in subject contours and core elements to keep generated images consistent.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-3.0-omni
docs.text: Kling IMAGE 3.0 Omni focuses on cinematic narrative stills and richer image storytelling, extending Kling's image workflow with Image Series Mode and direct 2K/4K Ultra HD model output for finer texture rendering and smoother colour transitions.

docs.subject: ent_kling-image-o1
docs.text: Kling IMAGE O1 is Kling's unified visual creation image model, built on a new engine and described by Kling as a versatile AI visual creation tool that enables efficient creative realization through precise control and diverse capabilities.

docs.subject: ent_ltx-2.3-fast
docs.text: LTX-2.3 Fast is the rapid-generation model of Lightricks' LTX-2.3 family, producing up to 4K video with synchronized audio at cinematic frame rates (24/48 fps), with first-to-last frame control for image-to-video and sharp detail with accurate prompt handling. Unlike LTX-2.3 Pro it does not support audio-to-video.

docs.subject: ent_ltx-2.3-pro
docs.text: LTX-2.3 Pro is the full-featured model of Lightricks' LTX-2.3 family, generating up to 4K video with synchronized audio from text, image or audio input and supporting editing operations such as retake, extend and reframe.

docs.subject: ent_ltx-2.5-fast
docs.text: LTX-2.5 Fast is the speed-optimized model of Lightricks' LTX-2.5 family, generating portrait and landscape video with synchronized audio up to 4K at cinematic frame rates, with stronger prompt adherence and finer detail in texture, faces and typography, plus automatic duration selection from the prompt.

docs.subject: ent_ltx-2.5-pro
docs.text: LTX-2.5 Pro is the production-quality model of Lightricks' LTX-2.5 family, generating portrait and landscape video with synchronized audio up to 1080p at cinematic frame rates from text, image or audio input, with refined prompt interpretation and texture detail and automatic duration selection.

docs.subject: ent_dpt-2
docs.text: DPT-2 is LandingAI's second-generation Document Pre-Trained Transformer, the model behind Agentic Document Extraction's Parse API: it identifies document layouts and chunks and generates descriptive captions for those chunks. It adds agentic table captioning with cell-level grounding, refined figure and logo captioning, smarter layout detection on poor scans, and recognition of attestations such as signatures, stamps and seals, ID cards, barcodes and QR codes.

docs.subject: ent_dpt-3-fast
docs.text: DPT-3 Fast is the speed-oriented of the two Document Pre-Trained Transformer models that power LandingAI's ADE Parse, which converts documents into accurate machine-readable formats with layout preserved and precise citations. It returns Markdown and JSON with a document hierarchy of pages, elements, table cells and visual lines plus bounding boxes and confidence scores.

docs.subject: ent_dpt-3-pro
docs.text: DPT-3 Pro is LandingAI's flagship Document Pre-Trained Transformer parsing model and the default for ADE Parse, converting PDFs, scans and images into accurate machine-readable Markdown and JSON with layout preserved. It returns a document hierarchy of pages, elements, table cells and visual lines together with a spatial grounding map, bounding boxes and confidence scores.

docs.subject: ent_landingai-ade-classify
docs.text: ADE Classify is LandingAI's document classification API: it assigns each page of a document to a class you define in natural language, so you can build page routers before parsing. It returns per-page labels with a reason field describing the page, marks unclassified pages as unknown, needs no fine-tuning or templates, and works in English and 20+ languages.

docs.subject: ent_llamaclassify
docs.text: Classify is the LlamaIndex product that routes documents into categories using natural-language rules, letting you label and dispatch incoming files before further processing. It is one of the six composable products of the LlamaParse platform, alongside Parse, Extract, Split, Sheets and Index.

docs.subject: ent_llamaextract
docs.text: LlamaExtract pulls structured data out of documents according to a schema you define (or one it infers), returning the result as JSON. It is one of the six composable products of LlamaIndex's LlamaParse platform and typically runs on the output of Parse.

docs.subject: ent_llamaparse
docs.text: LlamaParse is LlamaIndex's agentic OCR and document parsing product, turning PDFs, scans and images into clean markdown, text or JSON; LlamaIndex calls the surrounding platform the enterprise platform for turning documents into production AI pipelines. It handles 130+ formats and is the foundation most document pipelines start from before extraction, classification or indexing.

docs.subject: ent_llamasplit
docs.text: Split is the LlamaIndex product that segments concatenated documents into logical sections: you upload a combined PDF, define categories such as invoices, receipts or cover pages, and get back the page ranges for each document type. It is one of the six composable products of the LlamaParse platform.

docs.subject: ent_ray3.2
docs.text: Ray3.2 is Luma's current video generation model, which the company says turns creative intent into scalable video workflows with richer control, continuity and cinematic direction. It does text-to-video and image-to-video, Modify Video V2 on footage up to 20 seconds at 1080p, multi-keyframe direction with up to 16 keyframes per clip, and native 16-bit HDR generation with EXR export.

docs.subject: ent_uni-1.1
docs.text: UNI-1.1 is Luma's multimodal reasoning model for image generation, which Luma describes as thinking before it generates rather than simply responding to a prompt. It does text-to-image with reference-guided control (up to nine reference inputs per request), spatial reasoning and scene completion, and culture-aware generation across aesthetics and visual styles.

docs.subject: ent_magnific-upscaler-precision
docs.text: Magnific's Upscaler Precision is a faithful, high-fidelity upscaling model that raises resolution while preserving the original content, texture and structure of the image rather than inventing new detail. It minimizes halos, reduces noise, keeps colours accurate and improves the readability of small text and UI, and supports 2x, 4x, 8x and 16x factors — Magnific recommends it for logos, UI, product photos, scans and technical drawings.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-6
docs.text: Meshy-6 is Meshy's generational 3D-generation model focused on production-ready geometry: watertight meshes with cleaner topology out of the box, smoother and more anatomically correct characters and organic shapes, and sharper edges and cleaner silhouettes on hard-surface objects. It generates from text or an image and outputs textured, PBR-ready models, with Low Poly Mode for game engines and multi-colour 3D printing formats.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-7
docs.text: Meshy-7 is Meshy's image-to-3D foundation model, built around a single standard: the 3D result should agree with the image the user brought. Released in August 2026, it improves geometry alignment (overall proportion, spatial distribution and surface detail) and texture fidelity over Meshy-6, and accepts a single image or up to four ordered views of the same object.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-animation
docs.text: Meshy's Animation API applies a chosen animation action from Meshy's library to a previously rigged 3D character, with optional post-processing such as frame-rate change, format conversion and armature extraction. It takes a completed rigging task ID and an action ID and returns downloadable animated models in GLB, FBX and USDZ.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-auto-rigging
docs.text: Meshy's Rigging (auto-rigging) API automatically generates a skeletal structure for a 3D character so it can be animated; a successful rigging task is the prerequisite for Meshy's Animation API.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-remesh
docs.text: Meshy's Remesh API reprocesses an existing 3D model — from a previous Meshy task or a public model URL — and re-exports it with a chosen topology and polygon budget. It supports quad-dominant or decimated triangle meshes, target polycounts from 100 to 300,000, adaptive decimation, and export to GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, Blend, STL and 3MF.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-retexture
docs.text: Meshy's Retexture API applies new textures to an existing 3D model using Meshy's foundation models, driven by a text description of the desired style, a 2D reference image or 1-4 multi-view images. It accepts a previous task ID or a .glb/.gltf/.obj/.fbx/.stl model URL and returns the textured model plus base-colour and optional PBR maps at up to 8K.

docs.subject: ent_meshy-texture
docs.text: Meshy's text-to-texture capability, served by the Retexture API, generates textures for an existing 3D model from a text description of the desired style (up to 600 characters). It returns the textured model with base-colour and optional PBR maps (metallic, roughness, normal, emission) at up to 8K, keeping or regenerating the original UV layout.

docs.subject: ent_llama-guard-3-11b-vision
docs.text: Llama Guard 3 11B Vision is Meta's multimodal safety classifier: it evaluates the prompt text and the image together to decide whether a prompt is safe, using the vision understanding of Llama 3.2 11B-Vision. It answers safe or unsafe and, when unsafe, lists the violated hazard categories (S1-S13); it is optimized for English text and handles one image per prompt.

docs.subject: ent_llama-prompt-guard-2-22m
docs.text: Llama Prompt Guard 2 22M is the smaller of Meta's two BERT-based prompt-attack classifiers, trained on a large corpus of attacks to detect both prompt injections in untrusted inputs and explicitly malicious jailbreak prompts. It takes any string and returns a benign or malicious label; the 22M variant focuses on English and is meant for latency- or resource-constrained deployments.

docs.subject: ent_llama-prompt-guard-2-86m
docs.text: Llama Prompt Guard 2 86M is Meta's full-size BERT-based prompt-attack classifier, trained on a large corpus of English and non-English attacks to detect prompt injections and jailbreaks. It takes any string and returns a benign or malicious label, requiring no particular prompt structure or configuration.

docs.subject: ent_resnet-50
docs.text: ResNet-50 is a 50-layer residual convolutional neural network pre-trained on ImageNet-1k at 224x224 resolution; this is the v1.5 variant, which differs from the original in the downsampling of its bottleneck blocks and is slightly more accurate. It is used as a raw image classifier over the 1,000 ImageNet classes or as a backbone to fine-tune for other vision tasks.

docs.subject: ent_mindee-ocr-api
docs.text: Mindee's OCR API is the platform's raw-text utility model: it runs optical character recognition over an uploaded document image and returns its content as structured text, and underpins Mindee's extraction models, which combine OCR with visual layout understanding. Mindee describes models as configurable, reusable engines that automate turning unstructured document images into actionable, structured data.

docs.subject: ent_hailuo-02
docs.text: MiniMax Hailuo 02 is MiniMax's video generation model built on a Noise-aware Compute Redistribution (NCR) architecture, with native 1080p output, state-of-the-art instruction following and what MiniMax calls extreme physics mastery for intricate motion such as gymnastics. It is offered in 768p-6s, 768p-10s and 1080p-6s versions and supports start and end frames.

docs.subject: ent_image-01
docs.text: image-01 is MiniMax's text-to-image model, released in February 2025, which generates images from a text prompt in multiple output sizes.

docs.subject: ent_minimax-h3
docs.text: MiniMax-H3 is MiniMax's open general-purpose multimodal generation model: it understands a unified context of text, images, video and audio and generates video with native stereo sound at up to 2K resolution and 15 seconds, including multiple shots in one generation. It replaces separate specialist models for text-to-image, image-to-video, motion reference and audio with a single system that uses natural language as the bridge between modalities.

docs.subject: ent_minimax-speech-02-hd
docs.text: Speech-02-HD is the high-definition member of MiniMax's Speech-02 text-to-speech series, released in April 2025, which MiniMax describes as delivering hyper-realistic vocal performance with exceptional prosody and stability.

docs.subject: ent_minimax-web-search
docs.text: MiniMax's web_search tool performs a web search for a given query and returns structured results — title, URL, snippet and date — along with related search suggestions. It is provided through MiniMax's Token Plan search API and MCP server so coding agents can pull in current information during a task.

docs.subject: ent_speech-2.8-hd
docs.text: speech-2.8-hd is the high-definition model of MiniMax's Speech 2.8 text-to-speech series, released in January 2026, featuring Natural Sound Tags, lifelike voice and pristine audio quality.

docs.subject: ent_speech-2.8-turbo
docs.text: speech-2.8-turbo is the faster model of MiniMax's Speech 2.8 text-to-speech series, released in January 2026 alongside speech-2.8-hd, with Natural Sound Tags, lifelike voice and pristine audio quality.

docs.subject: ent_mistral-medium-2505
docs.text: Mistral Medium 2505 is Mistral Medium 3, a frontier-class language model that Mistral says delivers frontier performance while being an order of magnitude less expensive, and can be deployed in the cloud or self-hosted on four GPUs or more. It is aimed at coding, STEM reasoning, document understanding and dialogue; Mistral has since deprecated it in favour of Mistral Medium 3.5.

docs.subject: ent_mixedbread-indexing
docs.text: Mixedbread's indexing side is built on Stores: you upload PDFs, images, documents, code or video in any format and Mixedbread automatically parses, chunks and embeds them — including text, images, tables and complex layouts across 100+ languages — with no parsing pipeline, embedding model or vector database to manage.

docs.subject: ent_mixedbread-search
docs.text: Mixedbread Search queries a Store with a natural-language question rather than keywords and returns precisely ranked results optimized for AI applications, searching seamlessly across 100+ languages. Mixedbread positions it as a way to give agents verifiable context and reduce hallucinations, accessible via API, CLI and MCP.

docs.subject: ent_marey
docs.text: Marey is Moonvalley's image-to-video and text-to-video model for filmmakers, generating footage with cinematic detail, motion and lighting and trained exclusively on owned and licensed data, which Moonvalley presents as commercially safe. It is built for directed production work, with pose transfer, camera control, motion transfer and trajectory control.

docs.subject: ent_morph-compact
docs.text: morph-compact is Morph's verbatim context-compression model: it shrinks an agent's chat history by 50-70% at about 33,000 tokens/second, dropping irrelevant lines while keeping every surviving line byte-for-byte identical. It takes the history plus an optional query describing what the next call needs, and processes inputs up to 1M tokens in under two seconds.

docs.subject: ent_morph-reflex-v1
docs.text: morph-reflex-v1 is Morph's real-time per-turn text classifier, returning a verdict in about 90 milliseconds across eleven predefined categories including jailbreak attempts, NSFW content, stuck-in-a-loop behaviour, user frustration, leaked reasoning and domain or difficulty signals. It needs only text input and no training.

docs.subject: ent_morph-router
docs.text: morph-router is Morph's prompt classifier for model routing: in roughly 180 milliseconds it classifies a prompt's difficulty, ambiguity and domain and recommends the appropriate model tier rather than generating an answer. It was trained on millions of coding prompts.

docs.subject: ent_morph-warp-grep-v2
docs.text: morph-warp-grep-v2 is Morph's dedicated code-search LLM (WarpGrep), running in its own isolated context window and issuing up to 8 parallel tool calls per turn to locate code in about 3.8 steps. It searches local codebases and public GitHub repositories without cloning and returns the relevant context to the calling agent.

docs.subject: ent_mubert-text-to-music
docs.text: Mubert's Text-to-Music converts a text prompt into a unique, royalty-free music track generated at request time rather than pulled from a library of finished songs. It accepts duration from 15 seconds to 25 minutes plus genre, mood, intensity, BPM and format controls, and returns WAV or MP3 audio cleared for commercial use.

docs.subject: ent_falcon
docs.text: Falcon is Murf AI's text-to-speech API for real-time voice agents, which Murf calls the fastest, most natural TTS API for that use, returning first audio in under 100 milliseconds. It offers 150+ professional voices across 35+ languages, handles up to 10,000 concurrent calls, and supports voice cloning, data residency across 11 geographies and on-premise deployment.

docs.subject: ent_melotts
docs.text: MeloTTS is a high-quality multi-lingual text-to-speech library from MyShell.ai and MIT, supporting English (several accents), Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with the Chinese speaker handling mixed Chinese and English. It is fast enough for real-time inference on CPU and is released under the MIT licence for commercial and non-commercial use.

docs.subject: ent_nanonets-workflow
docs.text: Nanonets Workflows is the company's no-code layer for automating document-driven processes: it connects apps, databases and documents into unified workflows, applies Nanonets' production-ready AI models for extraction and classification without training, and adds human or automated approval and validation stages. It handles intake by email, mobile photo, scan or API and posts results into systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks and Salesforce.

docs.subject: ent_nomic-parse
docs.text: Nomic Parse turns large drawing sets, specs and complex PDFs into structured, LLM-ready representations with layout, OCR, tables and visual context preserved. It is part of Nomic's Agent API for architecture, engineering and construction data, and its structured chunks feed retrieval, extraction and agent workflows.

docs.subject: ent_oxylabs-web-scraper-api
docs.text: Oxylabs Web Scraper API is an all-in-one web data collection platform: you send a target URL or search query and it returns structured, parsed JSON — or raw HTML — without you building scraping infrastructure. It ships pre-configured endpoints for 38+ popular sites and handles proxy rotation, anti-bot protections, JavaScript rendering and location, language and header customization.

docs.subject: ent_isaac-0.1
docs.text: Isaac 0.1 is Perceptron's first perceptive-language model, a 2B-parameter open-weights vision-language model aimed at systems that understand and interact with the physical world. Perceptron says it matches or beats models many times its size on core perception, excelling at visual question answering, in-context learning of new visual concepts from a few annotated examples, OCR, and grounding with precise pointing and localization.

docs.subject: ent_isaac-0.2-1b
docs.text: Isaac 0.2 1B is Perceptron's compact 1B-parameter hybrid-reasoning vision-language model, adding optional reasoning via thinking traces, perceptive tool calling including the Focus zoom-and-crop system, stronger grounding, better OCR, better desktop use and improved structured output. Perceptron targets robotics, media search and industrial inspection, with the model deployable on commodity GPUs or edge devices.

docs.subject: ent_isaac-0.2-2b-preview
docs.text: Isaac 0.2 2B Preview is the 2B-parameter hybrid-reasoning vision-language model in Perceptron's Isaac 0.2 family, released as an open-weights preview for edge and low-latency deployment. It supports reasoning via thinking traces, perceptive tool calling with the Focus zoom-and-crop system, stronger grounding, better OCR, desktop and UI understanding, and reliable structured JSON output.

docs.subject: ent_perplexity-fetch-url
docs.text: fetch_url is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API that retrieves the content of specific web pages — up to 10 URLs per invocation — returning titles, snippets and full page text. It is used when the agent needs the full content of a particular page, article or document rather than search results.

docs.subject: ent_perplexity-finance-search
docs.text: finance_search is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API that plugs an agent into licensed financial datasets, real-time market feeds and cited web sources, returning ticker quotes, market data and financial metrics in a standard schema the model can reason over.

docs.subject: ent_perplexity-people-search
docs.text: people_search is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API for finding professionals and employees online; the agent generates search queries for the invocation and the tool returns matching results in Perplexity's standard search-result schema.

docs.subject: ent_perplexity-sandbox
docs.text: sandbox is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API that executes code in an isolated container during a request, capturing stdout, stderr, exit code and execution duration so an agent can run scripts and computations securely.

docs.subject: ent_perplexity-search-api
docs.text: The Perplexity Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data — title, URL, snippet and dates — without LLM processing, with controls for domains, languages, regions and extracted content. Perplexity recommends it when you need raw results to feed your own models or RAG pipelines, and it runs on the same index that powers Perplexity's answer engine.

docs.subject: ent_perplexity-web-search
docs.text: web_search is the built-in web search tool of Perplexity's Agent API, letting a model run searches with advanced filtering by domain and date, a configurable number of results (1-50) and a token budget for search context.

docs.subject: ent_veo-2
docs.text: Veo 2 is Google's stable line of video generation models, supporting text-to-video and image-to-video with style and asset reference images, prompt rewriting, and preview object insert/remove, producing silent 5-8 second 720p clips.

docs.subject: ent_veo-3
docs.text: Veo 3 is Google's line of video generation models supporting text-to-video and image-to-video with sound generation and prompt rewriting, producing 4, 6, or 8 second 720p or 1080p clips.

docs.subject: ent_veo-3-fast
docs.text: A Veo Fast version that lets developers create videos with sound while maintaining high quality and optimizing for speed and business use cases, such as programmatically generated ads and social media content.

docs.subject: ent_veo-3.1
docs.text: State-of-the-art cinematic video generation with advanced creative controls and natively synchronized audio, supporting video extension, frame-specific generation from first and last frames, and image-based direction.

docs.subject: ent_veo-3.1-fast
docs.text: The Veo 3.1 Fast version lets developers create videos with sound while maintaining high quality and optimizing for speed and business use cases; it also supports video extension and last-frame control.

docs.subject: ent_veo-3.1-lite
docs.text: Veo 3.1 Lite is an addition to the Veo 3 series of video generation systems capable of synthesizing high-quality, high-resolution video with audio from a text prompt or input image.

docs.subject: ent_lyria-2
docs.text: Lyria is a music generation model from Google; lyria-002 supports text-to-music with negative prompting, generating up to four instrumental audio clips of up to 32.8 seconds at 48 kHz WAV.

docs.subject: ent_lyria-3
docs.text: Lyria 3 is Google's family of music generation models, available through the Gemini API, generating high-quality 44.1 kHz stereo audio from text prompts or images with vocals, timed lyrics and instrumental arrangements.

docs.subject: ent_lyria-3-clip
docs.text: Optimized for generating short musical clips, loops, and previews up to 30 seconds, suited to speed and high-volume requests, with BPM and intensity controls.

docs.subject: ent_lyria-3-pro
docs.text: Google's flagship music generation model, optimized for full-length songs with complex structural coherence: distinct verses, choruses and bridges, with duration, BPM and intensity controls, up to 184 seconds.

docs.subject: ent_translation-llm
docs.text: Google's latest state-of-the-art translation model, TLLM is a Large Language Model that provides the highest available quality of translation and supports customization as well as lightweight Adaptive Translation.

docs.subject: ent_translation-llm-002
docs.text: The Translation LLM model version that supports supervised fine-tuning on Vertex AI, adapting translation behavior with a labeled dataset for domain-specific applications whose translations differ from general data.

docs.subject: ent_codey-for-code-completion
docs.text: code-gecko is the code completion model of the Vertex AI Codey APIs, released generally available alongside code-bison for code generation and codechat-bison for code chat.

docs.subject: ent_alphaevolve
docs.text: AlphaEvolve is an evolutionary coding agent powered by large language models for general-purpose algorithm discovery and optimization, pairing Gemini models with automated evaluators that verify answers within an evolutionary framework.

docs.subject: ent_qwen-3-235b
docs.text: Qwen3-235B-A22B is Alibaba's mixture-of-experts causal language model with 235B total and 22B activated parameters, built for reasoning, instruction-following, agent tasks and 100+ languages. It uniquely supports seamless switching between a thinking mode for complex logical, math and coding problems and a non-thinking mode for efficient general dialogue.

docs.subject: ent_wan-2.1-i2v
docs.text: Wan2.1 I2V is an image-to-video foundation model that animates a static input image, optionally guided by a text prompt, into a 720P high-definition clip. It is part of the Wan2.1 suite of video foundation models and uses a Diffusion Transformer framework.

docs.subject: ent_claude-3.7-sonnet
docs.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet was Anthropic's flagship model at release and the first hybrid reasoning model on the market, combining fast standard responses with an optional extended thinking mode. It shows particularly strong improvements in coding and front-end web development and is tuned for real-world business tasks rather than competition problems.

docs.subject: ent_arcade-tool-call
docs.text: Arcade is an enterprise-ready actions runtime for AI agents; a tool call is the mechanism by which an agent invokes one of Arcade's agent-optimized tools across 7,500+ integrated systems such as Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, GitHub and Stripe. Arcade handles the OAuth flows, user tokens and API keys at runtime and provides central governance and audit logging for every call.

docs.subject: ent_afm-4.5b
docs.text: AFM-4.5B is a 4.5 billion parameter instruction-tuned model from Arcee AI designed for enterprise deployment across cloud and edge environments. It is a decoder-only transformer trained on 8 trillion tokens with an emphasis on mathematical reasoning and code generation.

docs.subject: ent_argil-voice
docs.text: Voice is Argil's voice creation and cloning feature for AI avatars: users build a custom voice by uploading 20 seconds to 5 minutes of their own audio, pick one from the public voice library, or generate one from an image. Pro voices add higher-quality cloning through a connected ElevenLabs account, with roughly 30 supported languages and adjustable stability, similarity and style.

docs.subject: ent_universal-2
docs.text: Universal-2 is AssemblyAI's cost-effective pre-recorded speech-to-text model offering accurate transcription across 99 languages with low latency. It suits high-volume batch processing and any application needing coverage beyond the 18 languages of Universal-3.5 Pro.

docs.subject: ent_universal-3.5-pro
docs.text: Universal-3.5 Pro is AssemblyAI's flagship speech-to-text model for pre-recorded audio, delivering state-of-the-art accuracy on entities, rare words and domain-specific terminology with native code switching and optional contextual prompting. It is aimed at medical transcription, sales calls and meeting documentation where accuracy matters most.

docs.subject: ent_universal-streaming
docs.text: Universal-Streaming is AssemblyAI's real-time speech-to-text service for voice agents and live applications, taking audio over a WebSocket and returning transcribed text with rapid word-by-word updates at sub-300 ms latency. It is optimised for customer service applications, IVR systems and multilingual voice agents.

docs.subject: ent_bge-reranker-v2-m3
docs.text: bge-reranker-v2-m3 is a lightweight multilingual reranking model from BAAI built on BGE-m3 that takes a question and a document as input and directly outputs a relevance score rather than an embedding. It is used to rescore and reorder initial retrieval candidates, and is easy to deploy with fast inference.

docs.subject: ent_bge-small-en-v1.5
docs.text: bge-small-en-v1.5 is a small English embedding model in BAAI's BGE family that maps text to 384-dimensional dense vectors for semantic search and similarity. It is used for passage retrieval, clustering and semantic similarity, and works best when a short retrieval instruction is prepended to queries only.

docs.subject: ent_embedding-v1
docs.text: Embedding-V1 is Baidu's text embedding model on the Qianfan platform, generating a vector representation of input content for similarity search, clustering, recommendation and classification. Each text is limited to 384 tokens and 1,000 characters, with up to 16 texts per request.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-4.5-turbo-128k
docs.text: ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-128K is the long-context member of Baidu's ERNIE 4.5 Turbo text generation family on Qianfan, aimed at long document understanding and multi-turn conversation. It accepts up to 128k tokens of context and produces up to 12,288 output tokens.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-4.5-turbo-32k
docs.text: ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-32K is the 32k-context text generation model in Baidu's ERNIE 4.5 Turbo family on the Qianfan platform, offering the family's general instruction-following and reasoning ability at a shorter context length. It produces up to 12,288 output tokens.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-4.5-turbo-vl-32k
docs.text: ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-VL-32K is the vision-language variant of Baidu's ERNIE 4.5 Turbo family on Qianfan, accepting both text and images and returning text. It supports a 32k-token context and up to 12,288 output tokens.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-4.5-vl-424b-a47b-base-pt
docs.text: ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B-Base-PT is Baidu's multimodal mixture-of-experts base model with 424B total and 47B activated parameters per token, using a heterogeneous MoE structure with separate text and vision experts. It supports text understanding and generation, image understanding and cross-modal reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-5.0
docs.text: ERNIE 5.0 is Baidu's 2.4-trillion-parameter natively omni-modal foundation model, mapping text, images, video and audio into a shared token space within a single autoregressive framework for unified multimodal understanding and generation. It uses a sparse mixture-of-experts design with under 3% of parameters active per inference.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-5.0-thinking
docs.text: ERNIE-5.0-Thinking is the deep-reasoning variant of Baidu's ERNIE 5.0 on Qianfan, which emits an internal reasoning chain before producing its final answer. It supports 128k tokens of context, reasoning content of up to about 60k tokens and a maximum output of 65,536 tokens.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-5.1
docs.text: ERNIE-5.1 is the latest generation of Baidu's flagship ERNIE model on Qianfan, trained with separated fully-asynchronous reinforcement learning and enhanced for agent capability, knowledge integration, reasoning and deep search. It carries a 128k-token context window.

docs.subject: ent_ernie-x1.1
docs.text: ERNIE-X1.1 is Baidu's dedicated reasoning model on Qianfan, built on the ERNIE 4.5 multimodal foundation with an iterative hybrid reinforcement learning and self-distillation framework, and upgraded on factuality, instruction following and agentic capability. It offers a 64k-token context with extended chain-of-thought reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_musesteamer-air-image
docs.text: MuseSteamer-Air-Image is the text-to-image generation model in Baidu's MuseSteamer family on Qianfan, producing images from a written description. It accepts prompts of up to 800 characters.

docs.subject: ent_qianfan-ocr
docs.text: Qianfan-OCR is Baidu's 4B-parameter end-to-end document intelligence model that unifies document parsing, layout analysis and understanding in a single vision-language architecture, converting document images directly to Markdown. A prompt selects the task — structured parsing, table extraction, chart understanding, document question answering or key information extraction — and an optional Layout-as-Thought phase recovers explicit layout analysis.

docs.subject: ent_beatoven-composition
docs.text: Beatoven.ai's composition service generates original, royalty-free background music from a text description of the music that fits your content, using the company's own maestro model. Tracks are delivered with a licence that permits monetisation and can be downloaded as MP3 or WAV.

docs.subject: ent_flux-1-fill-pro
docs.text: FLUX.1 Fill [pro] is Black Forest Labs' image inpainting model: it takes an input image plus a black-and-white mask (or an embedded alpha mask) and a text prompt, and regenerates only the white masked areas according to the prompt. Options cover generation steps, guidance strength and output format.

docs.subject: ent_flux-1-pro
docs.text: FLUX.1 [pro] is Black Forest Labs' professional text-to-image model, described as a robust and proven baseline for generating high-quality visuals from written descriptions. It combines fast inference with strong prompt adherence and is available through the BFL API for embedding into pipelines and apps.

docs.subject: ent_flux-1.1-pro-ultra
docs.text: FLUX1.1 [pro] Ultra is the ultra-mode variant of Black Forest Labs' FLUX1.1 [pro] image generator, submitting an asynchronous text-to-image task with an optional raw mode for less processed, more natural-looking images. It supports image remixing from a base64 image prompt, aspect ratios from 21:9 to 9:21 and JPEG, PNG or WebP output.

docs.subject: ent_flux-3
docs.text: FLUX 3 is Black Forest Labs' latest model family for video generation, exposed through a single endpoint that supports text-to-video, image-to-video from keyframes, video continuation from an existing clip's final frames, and full-quality rendering of a previously generated draft. Clips run 5 to 20 seconds at HD or FHD with optional synchronized multilingual audio, speech and effects.

docs.subject: ent_flux-deblur
docs.text: FLUX Deblur is a Black Forest Labs FLUX Tools endpoint that regenerates a blurry image with a dedicated blur-removal model, sharpening it while preserving the original scene, objects, composition and lighting. No prompt is needed — the model applies a fixed blur-removal pass to the whole image.

docs.subject: ent_flux-erase
docs.text: FLUX Erase is a Black Forest Labs FLUX Tools endpoint that removes objects or regions from an image using a black-and-white mask, where white pixels mark the object to remove and black pixels are preserved. A dilate_pixels option expands the mask by up to 25 pixels to cover object edges.

docs.subject: ent_flux-kontext-pro
docs.text: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro] is Black Forest Labs' image creation and editing model, which takes a text prompt plus up to four reference images and either generates a new image or edits the supplied ones. It is now a legacy model, with FLUX.2 [pro] recommended for new integrations.

docs.subject: ent_flux-outpainting
docs.text: FLUX Outpainting places the input image on a larger canvas at a given offset and generates the surrounding region with a FLUX outpainting model, optionally guided by a text prompt. Its default "high" mode prioritises highest-fidelity detail and consistency, while a "fast" mode trades fidelity in the extended regions for speed.

docs.subject: ent_flux-vto
docs.text: FLUX VTO is Black Forest Labs' virtual try-on endpoint, generating an image of a person wearing supplied garments from a person image, one or more garment images and a text prompt that steers attribute transfer. Reference and output resolution are supported up to 4MP.

docs.subject: ent_brave-answers
docs.text: The Brave Answers API provides AI-generated answers backed by verifiable sources from the web, powering Brave's Ask Brave feature. It supports a fast single-search mode and a multi-search research mode, returns inline citations and usage metadata, streams responses and is OpenAI SDK compatible.

docs.subject: ent_brave-autosuggest
docs.text: The Brave Autosuggest API delivers query autocompletion and search suggestions as users type, adapted to their location and language. It can enrich suggestions with titles, descriptions and images, detect entities such as people or places, and tolerate typos.

docs.subject: ent_brave-spellcheck
docs.text: The Brave Spellcheck API provides spell checking for search queries, detecting spelling errors and returning corrected alternatives based on query context and search patterns. It is used for "Did you mean?" features and cleaning user-generated queries, and returns empty results when a query is already correct.

docs.subject: ent_bria-background-generation
docs.text: Bria's background generation route replaces the background of any image, generating a new backdrop around the preserved foreground subject. It is part of Bria's image editing suite of specialised endpoints.

docs.subject: ent_bria-background-removal
docs.text: Bria's Remove BG route removes the background of an image, isolating the foreground subject. It is one of the endpoints in Bria's image editing suite.

docs.subject: ent_bria-eraser
docs.text: Bria's Eraser route removes elements or specific areas from a given image while preserving the rest of the composition. It is part of Bria's image editing endpoints.

docs.subject: ent_bria-gen-fill
docs.text: Bria's GenFill route generates objects by prompt inside a specified region of an image, synthesising new content in the designated area from a text description. It is part of Bria's image editing suite.

docs.subject: ent_bria-image-expansion
docs.text: Bria's Image Expansion route expands an image by generatively extending the canvas and filling in the surrounding content. It is one of Bria's image editing endpoints.

docs.subject: ent_bria-increase-resolution
docs.text: Bria's Increase Resolution route upscales the resolution of any image, raising its pixel dimensions. It is part of Bria's image editing suite.

docs.subject: ent_bria-structured-prompt
docs.text: FIBO's structured prompt capability converts a short natural-language prompt into a machine-readable JSON schema that specifies every visual factor of the intended image. Because the schema can be versioned, automated and integrated into agentic workflows, it gives developers precise, reproducible control over generation.

docs.subject: ent_fibo-lite
docs.text: FIBO Lite is the smaller, faster, Docker-ready variant of Bria's JSON-native text-to-image model FIBO, intended for on-premises and local deployment. It keeps FIBO's controllability, prompt adherence and structured generation with minimal quality degradation.

docs.subject: ent_browser-use-cloud-agent
docs.text: Browser Use's Cloud Agent is a hosted service where you give an agent a task and get the result: the agent uses an AI model to understand the objective and drive a browser autonomously, without you controlling it directly.

docs.subject: ent_browser-use-session
docs.text: Browser Use's Cloud Browser lets you launch a hosted browser and connect to it from your own code: it returns a Chrome DevTools Protocol URL so tools such as Playwright or Puppeteer can drive the browser directly, rather than delegating the work to an agent.

docs.subject: ent_browserbase-session
docs.text: A Browserbase session is a managed, isolated headless browser instance from Browserbase's global fleet that lets an agent interact with websites the way a human would, including JavaScript rendering, login flows and interactive elements. Browserbase describes itself as the complete platform for building and deploying agents that browse and interact with the web.

docs.subject: ent_seed-2.1-pro
docs.text: Doubao-Seed-2.1-pro is the Pro tier of ByteDance Seed's Seed 2.1 family, a next-generation agent model for real-world productivity covering project planning, file processing and tool use, with strengthened end-to-end delivery in code engineering. It handles text, images, documents, charts and video, and performs strongly on long-context benchmarks.

docs.subject: ent_seed3d-2.0
docs.text: Seed3D 2.0 is ByteDance Seed's next-generation 3D generative model, producing high-precision geometry and unified PBR materials from a single image and extending to scene layout planning, part-aware decomposition and training-free articulation. Its simulation-ready output is aimed at physics and graphics engines, embodied AI and industrial use.

docs.subject: ent_seedance-1.0-pro
docs.text: Seedance 1.0 is ByteDance Seed's video generation model supporting multi-shot video generation from both text and image, creating 1080p videos with smooth motion, rich details and cinematic aesthetics. It maintains visual consistency across shots and handles complex action sequences and camera movements.

docs.subject: ent_seedance-2.5
docs.text: Doubao-Seedance-2.5 is ByteDance Seed's next-generation joint audio-video generation model built for 30-second storytelling, letting a single generation run up to 30 seconds and be extended twice. It accepts large numbers of image, video and audio references, supports timestamp-level editing, green screen and camera-perspective control, and can drive pacing and lip-sync from an audio track across 10+ languages.

docs.subject: ent_orpheus-v1-english
docs.text: Orpheus is Canopy Labs' open-source English text-to-speech system built on a Llama-3b backbone, generating human-sounding speech with natural intonation, emotion and rhythm. It supports zero-shot voice cloning, inline emotion tags such as <laugh> or <sigh>, and streaming output at roughly 200 ms latency for realtime use.

docs.subject: ent_ink-2
docs.text: Ink 2 is Cartesia's production speech-to-text model, described as the world's fastest and most accurate streaming speech-to-text model with native turn detection that senses when speakers begin and finish speaking. Audio is streamed to it and transcripts come back in real time, at around 100 ms transcript latency.

docs.subject: ent_ink-whisper
docs.text: Ink Whisper is Cartesia's most economical speech-to-text model, transcribing audio with better performance than baseline Whisper. It handles variable-length audio chunks and interruptions with dynamic chunking, copes with background noise, telephony artifacts, accents and disfluencies, and covers over 100 languages.

docs.subject: ent_line
docs.text: Line is Cartesia's platform for building and deploying intelligent, low-latency voice agents. It combines the Sonic text-to-speech and Ink speech-to-text models while handling audio orchestration and deployment.

docs.subject: ent_sonic-3.5
docs.text: Sonic 3.5 is Cartesia's production text-to-speech model, described as the world's fastest, most emotive and ultra-realistic option, streaming the first byte of audio in about 90 ms for real-time conversations. Text is streamed to it over a WebSocket and audio comes back in real time.

docs.subject: ent_sonic-3.6
docs.text: Sonic-3.6 is Cartesia's most lifelike text-to-speech model, released three months after Sonic-3.5 with fundamental model improvements and sub-90 ms latency plus native turn detection. Built on state space models, it is purpose-built for real-time voice agents and pairs with Ink-2 in one integration.

docs.subject: ent_sonic-turbo
docs.text: Sonic Turbo is a legacy Cartesia text-to-speech model whose latest snapshot supports nine languages including English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin, Japanese, Hindi and Korean. Cartesia recommends migrating to Sonic 3.5, and Sonic Turbo stops working after 20 October 2026.

docs.subject: ent_chunkr-extract
docs.text: Chunkr Extract auto-fills custom schemas from documents: given a document and a user-defined schema it returns structured JSON with the extracted values, citations showing where each value came from and confidence scores.

docs.subject: ent_chunkr-parse
docs.text: Chunkr Parse turns any document into LLM-ready data, converting PDFs, spreadsheets and images into machine-readable output such as markdown together with bounding boxes giving the location of each element.

docs.subject: ent_aya-expanse-32b
docs.text: Aya Expanse 32B is Cohere's highly performant 32B multilingual model, designed to rival monolingual performance across the languages it serves.

docs.subject: ent_aya-expanse-8b
docs.text: Aya Expanse 8B is Cohere's highly performant 8B multilingual model serving 23 languages. It is scheduled for retirement on 4 April 2026.

docs.subject: ent_cohere-rerank-3.5
docs.text: Rerank 3.5 is Cohere's reranking model for re-ranking English-language documents and semi-structured data such as JSON against a query, improving the ordering of retrieval results.

docs.subject: ent_command
docs.text: Command is Cohere's instruction-following conversational model that performs language tasks with high quality.

docs.subject: ent_command-light
docs.text: Command-light is a smaller, faster version of Cohere's Command model — almost as capable, but a lot faster.

docs.subject: ent_command-r-03-2024
docs.text: Command R 03-2024 is Cohere's instruction-following conversational model that performs language tasks at a higher quality, aimed at retrieval-augmented generation and tool use.

docs.subject: ent_command-r-plus-04-2024
docs.text: Command R+ 04-2024 is Cohere's larger instruction-following conversational model, best suited for complex RAG workflows and multi-step tool use.

docs.subject: ent_north-mini-code
docs.text: North Mini Code is Cohere's 30B total / 3B active parameter mixture-of-experts model trained specifically for agentic coding and released under Apache 2.0 for local deployment. It targets repository-level code modification inside agent frameworks, shell command execution across multi-turn interactions, and standalone code generation needing scientific or algorithmic reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_rerank-v4.0-fast
docs.text: Rerank 4 Fast is the light version of Cohere's rerank-v4.0-pro, optimised for low latency and high throughput when re-ranking documents and semi-structured data against a query.

docs.subject: ent_rerank-v4.0-pro
docs.text: Rerank 4 Pro is Cohere's multilingual reranking model for re-ranking documents and semi-structured data such as JSON against a query.

docs.subject: ent_composio-tool-router
docs.text: Composio's Tool Router replaces per-app MCP server setup with a single pre-signed MCP endpoint scoped to a user and chat session, giving agents dynamic tool discovery and authentication across thousands of tools. Composio calls it a dramatically simpler way to build complex agents and the core way of building on the platform.

docs.subject: ent_contextual-glm-v2
docs.text: Contextual GLM v2 is version 2 of Contextual AI's Grounded Language Model, an LLM engineered specifically to prioritise faithfulness to in-context retrievals over parametric knowledge in order to reduce hallucinations in RAG and agentic applications.

docs.subject: ent_contextual-lmunit
docs.text: LMUnit is Contextual AI's evaluation model: given a query, a response and a unit test, it returns the response's score on that unit test on a 5-point continuous scale. It is used for fine-grained, testable evaluation of LLM outputs.

docs.subject: ent_contextual-parse
docs.text: Contextual Parse is Contextual AI's document parsing component, which parses a file into structured Markdown and/or JSON for downstream retrieval and generation.

docs.subject: ent_ctxl-rerank-v2-instruct-multilingual
docs.text: ctxl-rerank-v2-instruct-multilingual is Contextual AI's instruction-following multilingual reranker, which ranks a list of documents by relevance to a query primarily and to custom instructions secondarily. It has been evaluated on instructions for recency, document type, source and metadata, and generalises to other instructions.

docs.subject: ent_ctxl-rerank-v2-instruct-multilingual-mini
docs.text: ctxl-rerank-v2-instruct-multilingual-mini is the smaller variant of Contextual AI's instruction-following multilingual reranker, ranking documents by relevance to a query and to custom instructions.

docs.subject: ent_did-v4-expressive-avatars
docs.text: D-ID's V4 Expressive Visual Agents are ultra-high-fidelity digital humans built on a diffusion-based model trained on real actor performances, for real-time LLM-connected conversation with sub-0.5-second turns as well as scripted long-form enterprise video. The avatar adapts its facial expressions and delivery to the context and sentiment of what is being said, with accurate lip sync in up to 4K.

docs.subject: ent_deepseek-r1-distill-llama-8b
docs.text: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B is an 8B model based on Llama-3.1-8B and fine-tuned on reasoning traces generated by DeepSeek-R1, demonstrating that reasoning patterns of larger models can be distilled into smaller ones. It targets mathematics, coding and general problem solving and emits detailed reasoning chains.

docs.subject: ent_deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b
docs.text: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is a 7B model built on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and fine-tuned on 800,000 samples generated by DeepSeek-R1, distilling the larger model's reasoning patterns into a compact architecture. It is used for text generation, mathematical problem solving, coding and general reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_deepseek-v3.2-tee
docs.text: This is a trusted-execution-environment deployment of DeepSeek-V3.2, DeepSeek's 685B-parameter language model that balances computational efficiency with advanced reasoning and adds "thinking with tools". Its key innovations are DeepSeek Sparse Attention for long-context efficiency, a scalable reinforcement learning framework and a large-scale agentic task synthesis pipeline.

docs.subject: ent_deepseek-v4-flash-0731-tee
docs.text: This is a trusted-execution-environment deployment of deepseek-v4-flash, the fast tier of DeepSeek's V4 family, currently at the 0731 snapshot. It supports both non-thinking and thinking (default) modes, JSON output and tool calls, and is API-compatible with both the OpenAI and Anthropic formats.

docs.subject: ent_aura-1
docs.text: Aura-1 is Deepgram's first-generation text-to-speech model, converting written text into natural-sounding spoken audio via an API request that names a voice. It offers 12 English voices spanning American, British and Irish accents, and has since been succeeded by Aura-2.

docs.subject: ent_deepgram-flux
docs.text: Flux is Deepgram's conversational speech recognition model built specifically for voice agents rather than passive transcription: it understands conversational flow and automatically handles turn-taking. It offers model-integrated end-of-turn detection, configurable turn-taking dynamics and ultra-low latency at Nova-3 level accuracy, in English-only and 10-language variants.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-multilingual-v2
docs.text: Eleven Multilingual v2 is ElevenLabs' high-quality speech synthesis model producing natural-sounding speech with high emotional range and contextual understanding across 29 languages. It is recommended for character voiceovers, professional content, multilingual projects and audiobooks, and accepts up to 10,000 characters per request.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-music
docs.text: Eleven Music is ElevenLabs' generative music model that creates original studio-quality instrumental or vocal tracks from a natural-language description. Users control genre, style and structure and can edit the sound and lyrics of individual sections or the whole song.

docs.subject: ent_eleven-sound-effects
docs.text: Eleven Sound Effects (Text to Sound v2) generates sound effects from a text description of the desired sound. It is language-agnostic and aimed at games, media production and multimedia projects.

docs.subject: ent_exa-answer
docs.text: Exa's Answer endpoint runs an Exa search and returns an LLM-generated response informed by the results, giving a direct answer for specific factual queries or a detailed summary with citations for open-ended research questions.

docs.subject: ent_exa-contents
docs.text: Exa's Contents endpoint returns the full page contents, summaries and metadata for a list of URLs, extracting clean LLM-ready web content including text, highlights, links and subpage information.

docs.subject: ent_exa-deep-search
docs.text: Exa Deep is Exa's agentic search tier, using optimised query expansion and LLM reasoning for high-quality results, and its Agent API performs asynchronous multi-step web research, list-building and enrichment with natural-language answers, structured outputs and citations.

docs.subject: ent_exa-search
docs.text: Exa's Search endpoint lets you search the web semantically and extract contents from the results, choosing the best search method automatically. It supports filters, freshness parameters and structured output for applications and agents.

docs.subject: ent_firecrawl-crawl
docs.text: Firecrawl's Crawl recursively traverses a website and gathers the content of every discovered page, giving complete site-wide coverage rather than isolated page fetches.

docs.subject: ent_firecrawl-extract
docs.text: Firecrawl's Extract performs LLM-powered structured data extraction from web content in JSON mode, turning unstructured pages into machine-readable records against a custom schema.

docs.subject: ent_firecrawl-interact
docs.text: Firecrawl's Interact lets you engage with a fetched page through code execution or AI prompts — manipulating elements, filling forms, clicking buttons or asking the browser to take further actions — which is useful for JavaScript-heavy sites and multi-step navigation.

docs.subject: ent_firecrawl-map
docs.text: Firecrawl's Map takes a website and returns all the URLs on it, extremely fast, giving a complete URL inventory of a site without fetching full page content.

docs.subject: ent_firecrawl-monitor
docs.text: Firecrawl's Monitor watches web content on a schedule with change detection and alerting — a single page, a whole website, or a continuous web search — and notifies you by webhook or email when something meaningful changes.

docs.subject: ent_mochi-1
docs.text: Mochi 1 is Genmo's open state-of-the-art video generation model with high-fidelity motion and strong prompt adherence, a 10-billion-parameter diffusion model using an Asymmetric Diffusion Transformer and released under Apache 2.0. It generates 480p MP4 clips from a text prompt, with optional negative prompts and LoRA weights.

docs.subject: ent_solaria
docs.text: Solaria is Gladia's speech-to-text model, presented as the first truly universal speech-to-text model covering over 100 languages with automatic language detection and mid-conversation code-switching. It is built for real-world audio — noise, accents, overlapping speakers — and serves meeting assistants, contact-centre monitoring, voice agents and media workflows in both real-time and batch modes.

docs.subject: ent_gemma-4-26b-a4b
docs.text: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT is Google DeepMind's instruction-tuned mixture-of-experts model with 25.2B total and 3.8B active parameters, making it an excellent choice for fast inference compared with larger dense models. It handles text and image input with text output and is well suited to reasoning, coding and agentic workflows.

docs.subject: ent_gemma-4-31b-turbo-tee
docs.text: This is a turbo, trusted-execution-environment serving profile of Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 31B, a 30.7-billion-parameter dense multimodal open model in the Gemma 4 family aimed at server and high-end workstation deployment. It takes text and images and returns text, using a hybrid local-sliding-window and global attention design for long-context reasoning.

docs.subject: ent_groq-compound
docs.text: Compound is Groq's agentic AI system that goes beyond plain LLM text generation by intelligently using built-in tools — Web Search, Visit Website, Code Execution and Wolfram Alpha — to reach real-time information and interact with external environments. It runs on models including GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 4 Scout and Llama 3.3 70B and can make multiple tool calls per request.

docs.subject: ent_groq-compound-mini
docs.text: Compound Mini is the lighter variant of Groq's Compound system for simpler use cases: it supports a single tool call per request and delivers on average 3x lower latency than Compound, trading multi-step tool capability for speed.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-ai-clipping
docs.text: HeyGen AI Clipping turns a long-form video into short highlight clips via POST /v3/ai-clipping, with target durations, portrait, landscape or square framing, and virality scores.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-avatar-iii
docs.text: Avatar III is HeyGen's v3 rendering engine built around a dedicated photo-to-video pipeline, with a higher-quality re-engineered model for photo avatars and video avatars.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-avatar-iv
docs.text: Avatar IV is the default HeyGen v3 rendering engine, offering the broadest avatar support, arbitrary image animation, a motion_prompt and expressiveness control.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-avatar-v
docs.text: Avatar V is HeyGen's highest-fidelity v3 rendering engine, using cross-reference-driven animation for the most natural motion and lip-sync, and is opted into per look.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-cinematic-avatar
docs.text: Cinematic Avatar is HeyGen's camera-directed avatar video type, layering multi-shot prompts, cinematic motion and scene direction on top of avatar speech.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-filler-word-removal
docs.text: HeyGen Filler Word Removal strips filler words such as "um" and "uh" and overlong silences from a finished video via POST /v3/filler-word-removals, returning one cleaned cut plus statistics.

docs.subject: ent_heygen-hyperframes
docs.text: HyperFrames is HeyGen's code-driven video framework that turns HTML compositions into rendered video, built around compositions, data attributes, variables and deterministic rendering.
